Job Title: Investment Funds & Asset Management Attorney

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Investment Funds & Asset Management Attorneys to contribute specialized legal expertise to an AI training project. The role involves analyzing fund-related legal documents, evaluating regulatory requirements, and reviewing AI-generated content to ensure accuracy and alignment with current industry standards. Prior AI experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Analyze and annotate legal documents related to investment funds, asset management, and securities regulation.
  2. Develop realistic legal questions, scenarios, and case studies covering fund formation, compliance, and investor relations.
  3. Review and validate AI-generated legal content for accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  4. Research and summarize developments in global fund structures, SEC regulations, and private equity, hedge fund, and mutual fund markets.
  5. Provide detailed feedback on complex legal concepts, risk management, and asset management best practices.
  6. Collaborate remotely with project teams and communicate findings clearly across all deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active bar membership in good standing.
  2. Recent, substantial experience advising on investment funds and asset management matters.
  3. Strong knowledge of U.S. and international securities laws, fund governance, and compliance requirements.
  4. Experience drafting and reviewing offering memoranda, subscription agreements, and regulatory filings.
  5. Excellent legal research, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  6. Familiarity with fintech and AI applications in financial services is an advantage but not required.
  7. Strong attention to detail, commitment to accuracy, and ability to stay current with regulatory and industry developments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A detail-oriented legal professional with extensive investment funds and asset management expertise, strong regulatory knowledge, and the ability to deliver clear, accurate, and well-supported legal analysis for technology-driven projects.

raw.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, R&D AI Services, you embed directly with product development teams to understand real business problems and work out the right way to solve them with AI: reusing and extending an existing AI service, or — when nothing suitable exists — scoping the requirements and working with the engineering team to build one. You are the bridge between a product team's business flow and a working AI capability: you know the AI service catalogue well enough to match the right service to the problem, you help teams build AI-first applications on top of it, and when a gap exists, you make sure the right thing gets built to close it.

This is a high-agency role for a hands-on senior engineer who is as comfortable in a stakeholder conversation about a business process as they are building and shipping the data pipeline or model-serving system behind it.

What you'll do

  • Embed directly with product teams (your internal customers) to understand their business flows and work out where AI genuinely helps

  • Lead technical discovery: separate the actual bottleneck in a business process from the symptom the product team came to you with
  • Know the existing catalogue of AI services well enough to spot where one could be applied or extended to solve a product team's problem, and help them design and build AI-first applications on top of it
  • Where no existing service fits, gather and document the requirements yourself, then partner with the engineering team responsible for AI services to scope, design, and build the new service — you're hands-on throughout, not just handing off a ticket
  • Get hands-on with the data pipelines, model training and serving, and MLOps tooling behind both new and existing AI services, plus the integrations that connect them into product workflows
  • Ship a working first version fast, then harden it: proper monitoring, feedback loops from real usage, and production-grade reliability
  • Translate product team pain points and business requirements into actionable input for the AI services roadmap
  • Work directly with product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering leads — going deep into the data and code while communicating trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Be the connective tissue between IFS R&D's AI capability and the product teams consuming it — your field insights shape what gets built next

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands-on capability building and deploying production systems and the ability to work across an unfamiliar stack when needed.
    • Languages: Strong Python, with the ability and willingness to work across other languages and existing customer codebases.
    • Cloud & Kubernetes: Experience building and operating cloud-native services. Azure experience - particularly AKS, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and Azure-hosted AI/model services - is highly relevant.
    • AI & LLM Integration: Experience integrating LLMs and AI services into production applications, including model APIs, authentication, gateways, reliability, latency, cost, and observability.
    • Agentic Systems: Experience building agentic applications using tools, APIs, and orchestration frameworks. Hands-on MCP experience is strongly preferred.
    • Retrieval & RAG: Hands-on experience designing production RAG and retrieval systems, including embeddings, vector databases, indexing, retrieval quality, and evaluation.
    • APIs & Enterprise Integration: Strong experience with REST APIs, authentication/authorization, external systems, data contracts, and debugging complex integrations.
    • Deployment & IaC: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD, and Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling.
    • Data & Storage: Comfortable working with data pipelines and across relational, document, vector, and object stores as required by the solution.
  • Solid understanding of event-driven and distributed systems architecture, applied pragmatically in delivery contexts rather than academically
  • Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, failure modes, and the trade-offs between quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
  • Experience building and owning production ML/data systems (not just notebooks or prototypes),
  • You thrive in ambiguity - you can turn "this business flow feels like it needs AI" into a scoped, shipped system without waiting to be told exactly what to build
  • You communicate well with non-technical stakeholders without dumbing down the substance
  • Experience working in or alongside platform or infrastructure teams
  • Able to work directly with customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguous business problems into technical solutions, rapidly prototype, and then productionize those solutions.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Reports can be submitted through the application at , available on the website .

At IFS, we're building the next generation of AI-native enterprise software, transforming how some of the world's largest organisations manage assets, operations and critical services.

This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of modern AI engineering, building intelligent products that combine Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI and cloud-native technologies to solve complex, real-world business challenges at enterprise scale.

We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building production AI systems and excited by the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software.

Please note that this role requires demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and shipping production AI applications.

Candidates whose AI experience is limited to using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to assist software development, without demonstrable experience building AI-powered products or systems, will not meet the requirements for this role.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

As a Staff Developer, you will play a key leadership role within a software development team, balancing deep technical expertise with mentorship, project leadership, and delivery accountability. This position requires expert-level programming and system design capabilities, ownership of end-to-end project delivery, and a commitment to software development best practices.


You will lead technical initiatives, guide and mentor team members, contribute to architectural decisions, and help shape engineering standards while working across cross-functional teams. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a highly collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges while helping others grow.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of large-scale engineering projects from design through implementation and deployment.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers across the team.
  • Create and review high-level and low-level design documentation.
  • Drive software quality through coding best practices, unit testing, and test automation.
  • Participate in Agile development activities including daily standups, retrospectives, and sprint planning.
  • Ensure adherence to architectural standards, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and engineering best practices.
  • Take ownership of production issues and identify long-term solutions to prevent recurrence.
  • Develop reusable design patterns and scalable software solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, UX, and Engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.
  • Influence technical direction across teams and help drive alignment toward target architecture.
  • Coach and mentor team members through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Lead incident response reviews and effectively communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Support team delivery by helping prioritize work, unblock teammates, and ensure commitments are met with quality and timeliness.

About You

  • Extensive experience designing, building, and delivering complex software systems.
  • Strong expertise in software engineering, system design, and modern development practices.
  • Experience with Golang, Python, and related development ecosystems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical projects and influence outcomes across teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and develop effective solutions.
  • Deep understanding of software development best practices, including testing, automation, code quality, and architecture.
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers at various levels.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to align technical decisions with business objectives and organizational goals.
  • A growth mindset with the ability to learn new technologies, frameworks, and domains independently.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • RRSP contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Family-forming benefits, enhanced maternity benefits, and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 75,000 to 246,000 CAD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

✨ Social Media Sorcerer/Sorceress at DeepReel: Make AI Go Viral! ✨

Who We Are

Hey there! We're DeepReel – an AI startup creating awesome videos with lifelike AI avatars. We transform simple prompts into professional videos automatically. Our AI Video Genie handles everything from script writing to selecting visuals, music, and captions—eliminating the need for filming and editing.

We've got solid backing from top Silicon Valley investors and the UK government's Innovation agency. We work with elite athletes, Hollywood celebrities, and thousands of businesses to help them share their stories with AI-generated videos. Check us out at !

The Role (TL;DR)

We're on the hunt for a creative and internet-savvy Social Media Manager to become the voice of DeepReel! If you live and breathe social media, know how to make content pop, and can turn followers into fans, this is for you. You'll be responsible for growing our online presence, engaging our community, and basically making DeepReel the coolest AI kid on the block. This role is perfect for a recent grad or someone with 1 year of experience who's ready to make a massive impact.

What You'll Actually Do (The Fun Stuff!):

  • Craft Epic Content: Dream up and create thumb-stopping posts, stories, Reels, TikToks, and maybe even a viral meme or two across all our platforms.

  • Be Our Online BFF: Engage with our community, respond to comments and DMs with wit and charm, and build a tribe of DeepReel enthusiasts.

  • Trend Spotting Guru: Keep your finger on the pulse of the latest social media trends, viral challenges, and AI buzz – then figure out how DeepReel can join the party.

  • Grow Our Empire: Develop and execute strategies to boost our followers, engagement, and brand awareness.

  • Analyze & Optimize: Track what's working (and what's not!), dive into analytics, and use data to make our social game even stronger.

  • Collaborate Like a Pro: Work with our marketing and product teams to shout about new features, success stories, and all things DeepReel.

We're Looking For (Must Haves):

  • Social Media Native: 0-1 year of hands-on experience managing social media accounts (internships, personal projects, or that side hustle count!).

  • Your Own Social Kingdom: A personal social media account (Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube Shorts, etc.) with a significant and engaged following. You don't just talk the talk; you walk the walk! (Be ready to share your handles!)

  • Content Creation Chops: Proven ability to create engaging and visually appealing content (graphics, short videos, killer copy).

  • Platform Pro: Deep understanding of major social media platforms: Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

  • Communication Wizard: Excellent English written and verbal communication skills – you're the voice of DeepReel, after all!

  • AI Enthusiast: Genuine excitement about generative AI, video technology, and the future we're building.

  • Hustle & Heart: A proactive, can-do attitude, ready to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment.

Bonus Points For (Impress Us!):

  • Basic video editing skills (e.g., CapCut, Adobe Premiere Rush).

  • Experience with social media scheduling and analytics tools.

  • A knack for graphic design (Canva wizards welcome!).

  • You’ve successfully grown a brand or community account before.

  • Your meme game is legendary.

Our Social Playground (The Tools You'll Use):

  • Platforms: Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and wherever the next big thing pops up!

  • Creative Tools: Your favorite content creation apps (including DeepReel!)

  • Analytics & Scheduling: We'll equip you with the best!

Why Join Us?

  • Surf the AI Wave: Work at the cutting edge of Generative AI – this is where the future is happening!

  • Be Heard & Seen: Have a massive impact on our brand's voice, visibility, and community growth.

  • Grow With Us: Incredible learning opportunities and the chance to shape the social media strategy of a rapidly growing startup.

  • Competitive Early-Career Compensation: Competitive salary that will grow with DeepReel's follower count and engagement!

Junior Software Developer

The Opportunity

CACI’s growing Agile Digital Solutions Operating Group is seeking a Junior Software Developer to support the modernization and transformation of enterprise business solutions used by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). The selected candidate will work closely with senior engineers, product owners, and data platform specialists to develop, test, and maintain capabilities supporting the Agency Data Catalog and Open Innovation Products. This role is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about modern software engineering, cloud technologies, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the development, testing, and maintenance of modern software solutions using established software engineering practices, including version control, code reviews, documentation, and automated testing.
  • Implement features and enhancements for the Agency Data Catalog and Open Innovation Products under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between enterprise systems through APIs, data ingestion pipelines, and database connections.
  • Support cloud-based development, deployment, and operational activities within secure environments.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and product stakeholders to deliver user-focused capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot application issues, investigate defects, and participate in root cause analysis and resolution efforts.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including user stories, implementation notes, and configuration documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Learn and apply engineering best practices related to CI/CD, infrastructure automation, code quality, and secure software development.
  • Contribute effectively within a fully remote team by communicating proactively, managing workload independently, and delivering on commitments with minimal day-to-day supervision.
  • Maintain a professional home-office environment with reliable internet connectivity and the ability to participate fully in virtual collaboration, meetings, and development activities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Relevant experience or certifications may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience developing software with Python through professional experience, internships, academic coursework, or personal projects.
  • Experience working with relational databases and writing SQL queries.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle concepts, source control systems such as Git, and Agile development methodologies.
  • Basic understanding of web services, REST APIs, and data-driven applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work through technical challenges and unfamiliar problems with persistence, resourcefulness, and a commitment to seeing issues through to resolution.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Strong personal accountability and the ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining consistent progress and communication.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality work.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a NASA Public Trust background investigation.

Desired Qualifications

  • Internship, academic, or project experience developing software applications or data-driven solutions.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools.
  • Exposure to data management, data catalog, metadata, or data governance concepts.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Databricks, Microsoft Purview, Apache Airflow, GitLab, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting the federal government.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$53,100-$106,300

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Help us transform and bring innovation to Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance!
Veeva is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join the Safety Professional Services team and support implementations of our Vault Safety solution. We want innovative thinkers with deep implementation expertise who are ready to challenge the status quo with new technology.
As a key member of our Professional Services team, you will work side-by-side with customers and our manager to implement Vault Safety. In this role, you will drive the overall delivery of Vault Safety covering the Project Manager and/or Solution Architect role. You will define and drive business processes, drive the project team in delivering the solution, and guide our customers throughout the implementation programs and best practices.
Opportunities are available across Germany for this role; this is a 'work anywhere' position, as long as you are close to an airport and are able to meet travel requirements. Qualified candidates based in Germany are encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Drive life sciences, customers, in the rapid configuration and implementation of Vault Safety.
  • Act as project manager and/or solution architect in global or complex implementations across all the different phases: workshop preparation and delivery, requirements gathering, gap analysis, configuration, validation, and customer training.
  • Deliver subject matter expertise on implementation methodology and best practices.
  • Collaborate with partners involved during the implementation.
  • Collaborate with internal and cross-team stakeholders and contribute to the Safety practice development.
  • Mentor project team and junior consultants.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of working experience in the life sciences industry with the majority spent in Drug Safety, Pharmacovigilance, Healthcare, or adjacent Safety Industry
  • 3+ years spent in a technology consulting role with solid experience in complex or global implementation projects as one of the following: consultant, business/functional analyst, or project manager
  • Excellent knowledge of implementation methodologies for SaaS solutions
  • Proven ability to deliver on quality, time, and budget
  • Longstanding passion for technology and hands-on experiences
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Fast learner, ability to adapt, and to embrace changes
  • Proactive with good interpersonal skills, a good team player
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Fluent in a second language: Italian, Spanish, French, or German
  • Proficiency in MS Office (e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Ability to travel upon business requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required

Nice to Have

  • Fluent in 2nd language: Spanish, French, Italian, or German
  • Direct experience with systems such as Oracle Argus, ARISg, and/or other drug safety applications

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

  • Total compensation: 90,000 - 150,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

raw.description:
Role Summary

The Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading the organization's commercial strategy, revenue generation, sales operations, business development, and market expansion across insurance and investment services. The role focuses on driving sustainable revenue growth, increasing market share, developing strategic partnerships, expanding distribution channels, and maximizing commercial performance across business units and markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Strategy: Develop and execute group-wide commercial strategies, sales plans, and revenue growth initiatives across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, expand market presence, and establish strategic partnerships with insurers, banks, brokers, investors, and financial institutions.
  • Sales Leadership: Lead sales, business development, relationship management, and distribution teams to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Insurance Business Growth: Drive insurance premium growth, product distribution, policy acquisition, renewals, and expansion of insurance brokerage or agency networks.
  • Investment Business Development: Develop commercial strategies for investment products, asset management services, wealth management, and institutional investment relationships, where applicable.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Build and manage relationships with corporate clients, institutional investors, insurance providers, intermediaries, and distribution partners.
  • Market Expansion: Identify new geographical markets, customer segments, and distribution channels to strengthen competitive positioning.
  • Revenue & Profitability Management: Oversee commercial budgets, sales forecasts, pricing strategies, pipeline management, and revenue performance.
  • Customer & Relationship Management: Strengthen client acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Commercial Performance: Establish KPIs, monitor sales performance, evaluate market trends, and report commercial results to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.
  • MBA or master's degree in Business, Finance, or Marketing preferred.
  • Typically 12–18+ years of experience in commercial leadership, business development, sales, insurance, investments, or financial services.
  • Significant experience leading commercial operations, revenue generation, and multi-channel sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of insurance products, investment services, wealth management, financial markets, and distribution models.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth, developing strategic partnerships, expanding market share, and achieving commercial targets.
  • Experience managing large client portfolios, institutional relationships, and cross-functional commercial teams.
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, financial analysis, communication, and strategic decision-making skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue growth and commercial profitability.
  • Insurance premium growth and policy acquisition.
  • Investment product sales and assets under management growth, where applicable.
  • New client acquisition and customer retention.
  • Market share and geographical expansion.
  • Strategic partnership and distribution-channel development.
  • Sales pipeline conversion and target achievement.
  • Cross-selling and customer lifetime value.

raw.description:
CARE Canada is looking for a Senior Analyst, Cash Management and Automation (12-month contract)

ABOUT THE ROLE

CARE Canada’s bold Strategic Plan, From Caring Comes Courage (2021 – 2027), sets out CARE Canada’s commitment to bring all our resources, talent, and expertise together to unlock women’s leadership for a gender-just future. It recognizes that to lead change and realize a better life for herself and her community, every woman needs to be safe, healthy and have a dignified livelihood. It also fundamentally realizes that ‘business as usual’ is no longer good enough: this Plan challenges us to reimagine how we achieve our mission, inspire Canadian investment in that mission, and transform our organization to be future-ready.

The Corporate Finance Team hosts the financial and information management components for the broader organization.  Along with the traditional accounting and financial stewardship role, this unit provides financial and professional expertise and oversight to HQ and Country Office operations in an efficient and effective manner. This unit is a key resource in strategic planning and leads in budgeting, forecasting and business analysis and compliance.

The Senior Analyst, Cash Management and Automation plays a key role in strengthening treasury operations, cash management, and foreign exchange (FX) risk management. This position has day-to-day responsibility for treasury monitoring, investment oversight, FX management, and financial control enhancement.

The Senior Analyst, Cash Management and Automation is also responsible for driving organization effectiveness through the analysis, design, and implementation of process improvements within corporate finance.

The Senior Analyst, Cash Management and Automation is the lead on automation initiatives for corporate finance in conjunction with other departments

WHAT YOU BRING

3+ years of progressive finance experience. Working knowledge of treasury management and/or investment oversight. Demonstrated knowledge of multi-currency transactions and FX risk. Understanding of restricted fund/project accounting. Experience interacting with auditors and external stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to operate independently and exercise sound judgment. Strong analytical, governance, and risk management capabilities.

WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU EXTRAORDINARY

Experience in international development or complex funding environments Exposure to controllership functions. Demonstrated leadership potential.

REQUIREMENTS

Promote and maintain an organizational culture that advances gender equality, reduces power abuse and inequalities, and fosters trust and safety.

Create an environment within CARE's workplaces, programming, and communities where CARE works that is free from sexual harassment, sexual abuse and sexual exploitation and child abuse (SHEA-CA).   Ensure high standards of prevention and response measures for SHEA-CA are in place consistent with the CARE International (CI) Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct.

WHAT WE OFFER

Starting salary between $92,920 - $97,970 Comprehensive benefits package, providing family coverage for a wide range of services, including paramedical services, gender-affirming care, mental health support, and access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Paid annual and wellness leave benefits Extended list of paid holidays, beyond provincial requirements December Office Closure (between December 24-January 1) Inclusive holiday policy Parental leave top-up Employer contributions to group pension plan beginning in 2nd Year; Optional participation in group RRSP International and domestic travel opportunities Annual all-staff retreat Learning and development opportunities and specialized training Flexible work hours to support employee wellbeing and productivity A focus on wellness and work-life balance Amazing colleagues who are very committed to CARE’s mission

HOW TO APPLY

If you are someone who thrives on challenge, loves to be part of a dynamic team and you are passionate about making a difference, then this opportunity is for you! Don’t think you check all the boxes? Reach out anyway – we would love to hear how your experience translates to this role!

Please apply directly by November 16, 2026. Please note that resumes will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and the advertisement will be removed once a candidate has been identified. We are only able to consider candidates who currently have the right to work in Canada. CARE Canada is committed to employment equity, welcomes diversity in the workplace and encourages applications from all qualified applicants. Recruitment-related accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request.

CARE Canada does not use artificial intelligence tools to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All application reviews and hiring decisions are conducted by our amazing people. AI tools may be used in drafting communication, editing or interview question sourcing from time to time.

This posting is for a currently vacant role.

As part of CARE Canada's commitment to preventing sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, we conduct reference checks on all final stage candidates in line with the Interagency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. By applying to this role with CARE Canada, you are giving us consent to contact your previous employers to seek information in line with this scheme.

Job Title: Cloud Migration Engineer
Location: Remote
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]
Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Cloud Migration Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate cloud or enterprise infrastructure and platforms. The work focuses on availability, scalability, security, observability, automation, and dependable service operations. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in the primary programming language and framework, APIs, SQL, testing, Git, and CI/CD, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, provision, configure, and operate cloud or infrastructure components using approved architecture patterns.
  • Automate repeatable provisioning, deployment, configuration, and operational tasks.
  • Implement security, identity, networking, backup, monitoring, and availability controls.
  • Investigate incidents, capacity issues, vulnerabilities, and performance problems.
  • Maintain runbooks, diagrams, standards, and change records; collaborate across engineering and operations.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience Required: typically 4+ years in a related professional role; exact threshold must match the approved requisition.
  • Practical experience with the role-specific technology stack: the primary programming language and framework, APIs, SQL, testing, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Professional experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or systems operations relevant to the role.
  • Hands-on knowledge of the named cloud, operating-system, container, or automation technologies.
  • Understanding of networking, identity, security, monitoring, and availability fundamentals.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, source control, or infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and production issues methodically.
  • Strong documentation and cross-team collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Additional hands-on depth in the primary programming language and framework, APIs, SQL, testing, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with cloud services, automation, and modern delivery practices relevant to the project.
  • Familiarity with secure development, accessibility, governance, or regulatory requirements where applicable.
  • Relevant professional certifications or advanced training in the role’s technology area.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact Venkat Raju at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreKLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies.
raw.description:
Who We Are

KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies. Our technology-enabled services and software help these law firms, corporations and agencies solve complex data challenges. Our Nebula and RelOne platforms deliver SaaS-based legal technology underpinned by managed services and professional services. The company, with offices in 26 locations across 17 countries helps clients with their litigation, regulatory compliance, internal investigation and data recovery and management needs all around the world.

Serving clients for over 30 years, KLDiscovery offers data collection and forensic investigation, early case assessment, electronic discovery and data processing, application software and data hosting for web-based document reviews, and managed document review services. In addition, through its global Ontrack Data Recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction and tape management.

KLDiscovery has been recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in North America by both Inc. Magazine (Inc. 5000) and Deloitte (Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500.Additionally, KLDiscovery is an Orange-level Relativity Best in Service Partner, a Relativity Premium Hosting Partner and Relativity’s 1st Service Provider partner, and maintains ISO/IEC 27001 Certified data centers.

The Director, Sales Development owns KLDiscovery's sales development function end-to-end, leading the Manager(s), Sales Development who in turn lead the Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) serving as the first point of engagement for new eDiscovery opportunities. Demand is driven by triggering legal events and existing relationships, but it also requires a disciplined, scalable top-of-funnel motion to expand current client relationships and win new ones across segments. The Director designs, builds, and scales that motion — and the managers who run it — so Account Executives and strategic sellers can focus on the highest-value conversations.

This is a strategic leadership role for a results-oriented sales leader who builds leaders as deliberately as they build pipeline. Within Revenue Operations, the Director owns SDR strategy, forecasting, and performance reporting across segments, and sets the standards that Sales Operations and the Manager(s), Sales Development execute against.

The Director, Sales Development is accountable for:

  • Achieving and exceeding team and segment pipeline targets

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with Sales, Client Solutions, and Revenue Operations leadership

  • Maximizing team performance, motivation, and retention across the sales development organization, and building team depth so results do not depend on a few individual managers or reps

  • Upholding performance and quality standards in line with best practice, procedures, and priorities, including MEDDPICC-based qualification discipline

  • Owning the sales development team budget

  • Promoting the KLDiscovery values and value proposition

How This Role Fits

KLD’s revenue team works as one connected chain: Sales Development opens and qualifies opportunities, Account Executives convert them, Sales Directors lead and inspect the segment, and Client Solutions and Client Success carry clients through delivery and expansion. Qualification follows MEDDPICC and Challenger methodology, Salesforce is the system of record, and territory and account ownership follow KLD’s rules of engagement.

The Director, Sales Development owns the first link end-to-end: setting the strategy, standards, and management structure that generate and qualify opportunities to the MEDDPICC standard so Account Executives receive pipeline they can convert, across every segment the function serves.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Hire, develop, and retain Sales Development Managers. Build a high-performing leadership bench through structured onboarding, clear performance expectations, and a defined path to senior sales leadership roles.

  • Coach managers to a consistent standard. Lead regular one-on-ones with the Manager(s), Sales Development and periodically audit call and email reviews to ensure consistent application of MEDDPICC and Challenger methodology across teams.

  • Set and manage performance standards across the function. Define quota, activity, and quality expectations for managers and their teams; measure results across segments; and hold managers accountable for addressing under-performance promptly and directly.

  • Build team depth. Develop the manager bench and plan succession for key leadership roles so sales development results are not concentrated in a small number of teams.

Drive Pipeline

  • Own demand-trigger strategy. Ensure managers and their teams track HSR second requests, major litigation filings, and regulatory investigations, and refine KLD’s capture framework based on what converts.

  • Own qualification standards enterprise-wide. Require every opportunity across every segment to meet MEDDPICC criteria before handoff to an Account Executive, protecting pipeline coverage accuracy at scale.

  • Expand named accounts and the installed base across segments. Within territory rules of engagement, direct managers and their teams to multi-thread stakeholders (General Counsel’s office, litigation support, procurement) and to surface Nebula and AI Case Explorer attach opportunities with Sales and Client Solutions.

  • Own law firm channel strategy. Set the strategy for engagement with firms eligible for KLD’s matter demand-generation incentive programs, track participation across the portfolio, and surface referral-ready relationships to senior sales leadership.

Forecasting, Reporting, and Process Ownership

  • Forecast SDR-sourced pipeline across segments. Consolidate forecasts of meetings, qualified opportunities, and expected conversion from each manager; flag gaps early to the VP, Revenue Operations and Sales Leadership; and own corrective action.

  • Report on function performance. Partner with Sales Operations on Salesforce dashboards covering activity, stage conversion, handoff acceptance, qualification quality, and sourced pipeline across every segment, and present insights and recommendations to senior sales leadership in recurring business reviews.

  • Own SDR strategy and process. Partner with Sales Operations on lead routing, handoff criteria, SLAs with Account Executives, qualification standards, and territory rules. Own the SDR playbook, direct managers' adherence audits, and refine the playbook based on performance data.

  • Uphold data quality and drive change. Partner with Sales Operations to set CRM hygiene standards enterprise-wide, direct managers to audit adherence, roll out workflow and tooling changes (Salesforce, ZoomInfo, engagement platforms), and use conversion data to inform quotas, territories, and headcount planning across the function.

  • Partner across functions and influence senior stakeholders. Work with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Regional Sales Leadership, Account Executives, Client Solutions, and Marketing leadership on coverage, handoff, feedback loops, and campaigns, representing the sales development function in cross-functional and executive planning.

  • Own the team budget. Plan, manage, and track spend against approved targets for the sales development function.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every team, across every segment, consistently delivers pipeline and closed-won opportunities

  • MEDDPICC-qualification rate and handoff acceptance at or above 80% enterprise-wide, not just meeting volume

  • Growth in multi-threaded contacts and documented Nebula / AI Case Explorer attach opportunities

  • Tracked, active law firm relationships in matter demand-generation programs

  • Consolidated SDR forecast accuracy within ±10% across all segments, with timely, accurate reporting and CRM data quality at 90% completeness on required fields

  • A fully staffed, well-ramped sales development organization — managers and SDRs alike — with strong engagement, low attrition, and clear progression into Account Executive, management, and other senior roles

  • Spend within the approved team budget

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of sales development, business development, or sales experience, including 5+ years managing people managers or leading multiple quota-carrying teams

  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding pipeline and team targets across multiple teams or segments, and of hiring, developing, and retaining both individual contributors and managers

  • Experience building forecasts and performance reports from Salesforce (or a comparable CRM) and defining and enforcing sales processes such as lead routing and handoffs across multiple teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to engage and influence legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate litigation, regulatory, and M&A signals into organizational strategy

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

  • Experience building or scaling a sales development organization across multiple teams or segments, including structure, hiring plan, processes, metrics, and onboarding

  • Background in legal technology, eDiscovery, or complex B2B/enterprise software, including exposure to corporate legal departments or law firms

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and/or Challenger Sale, with experience coaching managers and sellers to apply them at scale

  • Experience in or alongside Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with dashboarding skills and signal-based prospecting or sales engagement tools

MBA, JD, or equivalent qualification

Our Mission & Values

Our Mission: We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

These four values guide how we operate, make decisions, and work together every day.

  • Client is Always in the Room - We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

  • Own the Outcome - We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients, and each other.

  • Better Every Day - We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

  • Deliver Results Together - We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

KLDiscovery is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, discipline, and termination. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and experience.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING FOR KLD (ALL LOCATIONS)

At KLD, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that when our employees feel supported, valued, and empowered, they can thrive both personally and professionally. That’s why we’re committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can grow your career, make meaningful contributions, and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

Our competitive benefits and programs are designed to support your well-being and success. Depending on your location, these may include comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement and financial programs, paid time off and leave options, employee assistance resources, and professional development opportunities.

We also embrace flexibility, offering remote work opportunities for most employees to support work-life balance while keeping our teams connected and collaborative. Certain roles may require an office-based or hybrid schedule based on business and operational needs.

Wherever you’re located, you’ll be part of a global team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and celebrates your success.

Benefits and eligibility vary by country, location, employment status, and applicable plan or program requirements.

This position exercises a wide degree of creativity, latitude, discretion, and independence to accomplish goals, objectives, and assignments.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Personal:

  • Be a maturing disciple of Jesus Christ: growing in love for God, God's Word, God's people of every ethnicity and culture, and God's purposes in the world
  • Maintain spiritual disciplines for personal and ministry growth
  • Model wisdom and maturity in the balance of family, church, and ministry life

  • At higher levels, may oversee and supervise assigned administrative and operational associates and volunteers

  • Act as contact between supervisor, team members, and other staff directors, leaders, staff, faculty, and students

  • Other duties as assigned

Organizational Communication

  • Prepare, direct, and coordinate information between supervisor, campus staff and/or staff on other teams
  • Expedite and manage communication with team members, staff, vendors, program participants and others as needed
  • Manage and develop content for social media; monitor social media trends
  • Website maintenance as assigned
  • Partner with:
    • Human Resources on staff applications and performance reviews
    • Accounting on budgets and expense reports
    • Legal on contractual matters
    • Advancement on ministry partner development
  • Draft and maintain various forms of correspondence and communication

Develop and maintain a funding base and prayer support

  • Raise a portion of salary in an amount or percentage agreed upon with supervisor
  • Communicate regularly with current and potential donors, churches, prayer support team members, friends, and family regarding ministry with InterVarsity

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to handle sensitive information in a confidential manner
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships
  • Always demonstrates respect and professionalism
  • Commitment to and ability to work in a diverse environment
  • Appropriately self-manages time, projects, priorities, and assigned work
  • Work is accurate, thorough, timely, and of high-quality
  • Able to identify and resolve problems that inhibit the implementation of plans; perseveres to overcome obstacles and accomplish tasks
  • Works well under pressure, requires minimal supervision, takes initiative, is teachable, is a self-starter, offers suggestions and anticipates needs
  • Skilled at organization, planning, and hosting different types of events and meetings
  • Actively listens and gives appropriate feedback/responses

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior or current experience with InterVarsity as a staff member or student preferred

  • Familiarity with web-based applications and tools such as Google Docs, Zoom, Survey Monkey, Mail Chimp, and collaboration technology
  • Familiarity with social media tools such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc.
  • Available to travel for business to local and out-of-town management meetings, including the triennial Urbana Student Missions Conference and National Staff Conference

The staff is required to travel to on-campus and off- campus sites as appropriate. Off- campus travel includes, but is not limited to: student ministry conferences, Ministry Partnership Development meetings, and InterVarsity- sponsored training sessions, meetings, and conferences. We offer a competitive benefits package, including health care and retirement savings with a match. Eligibility is based on employee type and hours worked. Benefits include the following:

raw.description:
Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release)

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Required Skills:

  • Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)

  • Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM)

  • Nanoparticle Sizing

  • Particle Size Distribution

  • Quality Control

  • Lot Release

  • Nanomaterials

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity centers on thorough nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release qualifications using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). The engagement emphasizes independent expert analysis - including manual image thresholding, calibration, and morphology assessments - without reliance on automated or AI-powered tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential to document findings, interpret complex micrographs, and convey critical decisions to project stakeholders.

Scope of Work:

  • Manually analyze and interpret TEM and SEM micrographs for nanoparticle sizing and morphological assessment

  • Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with rigorous attention to accuracy and reproducibility

  • Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards

  • Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification

  • Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data

  • Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria

  • Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation

  • Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies

  • Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration

  • Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools

  • Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus

raw.excerpt: Who We AreKLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies.
raw.description:
Who We Are

KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies. Our technology-enabled services and software help these law firms, corporations and agencies solve complex data challenges. Our Nebula and RelOne platforms deliver SaaS-based legal technology underpinned by managed services and professional services. The company, with offices in 26 locations across 17 countries helps clients with their litigation, regulatory compliance, internal investigation and data recovery and management needs all around the world.

Serving clients for over 30 years, KLDiscovery offers data collection and forensic investigation, early case assessment, electronic discovery and data processing, application software and data hosting for web-based document reviews, and managed document review services. In addition, through its global Ontrack Data Recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction and tape management.

KLDiscovery has been recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in North America by both Inc. Magazine (Inc. 5000) and Deloitte (Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500.Additionally, KLDiscovery is an Orange-level Relativity Best in Service Partner, a Relativity Premium Hosting Partner and Relativity’s 1st Service Provider partner, and maintains ISO/IEC 27001 Certified data centers.

The Director, Sales Development owns KLDiscovery's sales development function end-to-end, leading the Manager(s), Sales Development who in turn lead the Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) serving as the first point of engagement for new eDiscovery opportunities. Demand is driven by triggering legal events and existing relationships, but it also requires a disciplined, scalable top-of-funnel motion to expand current client relationships and win new ones across segments. The Director designs, builds, and scales that motion — and the managers who run it — so Account Executives and strategic sellers can focus on the highest-value conversations.

This is a strategic leadership role for a results-oriented sales leader who builds leaders as deliberately as they build pipeline. Within Revenue Operations, the Director owns SDR strategy, forecasting, and performance reporting across segments, and sets the standards that Sales Operations and the Manager(s), Sales Development execute against.

The Director, Sales Development is accountable for:

  • Achieving and exceeding team and segment pipeline targets

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with Sales, Client Solutions, and Revenue Operations leadership

  • Maximizing team performance, motivation, and retention across the sales development organization, and building team depth so results do not depend on a few individual managers or reps

  • Upholding performance and quality standards in line with best practice, procedures, and priorities, including MEDDPICC-based qualification discipline

  • Owning the sales development team budget

  • Promoting the KLDiscovery values and value proposition

How This Role Fits

KLD’s revenue team works as one connected chain: Sales Development opens and qualifies opportunities, Account Executives convert them, Sales Directors lead and inspect the segment, and Client Solutions and Client Success carry clients through delivery and expansion. Qualification follows MEDDPICC and Challenger methodology, Salesforce is the system of record, and territory and account ownership follow KLD’s rules of engagement.

The Director, Sales Development owns the first link end-to-end: setting the strategy, standards, and management structure that generate and qualify opportunities to the MEDDPICC standard so Account Executives receive pipeline they can convert, across every segment the function serves.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Hire, develop, and retain Sales Development Managers. Build a high-performing leadership bench through structured onboarding, clear performance expectations, and a defined path to senior sales leadership roles.

  • Coach managers to a consistent standard. Lead regular one-on-ones with the Manager(s), Sales Development and periodically audit call and email reviews to ensure consistent application of MEDDPICC and Challenger methodology across teams.

  • Set and manage performance standards across the function. Define quota, activity, and quality expectations for managers and their teams; measure results across segments; and hold managers accountable for addressing under-performance promptly and directly.

  • Build team depth. Develop the manager bench and plan succession for key leadership roles so sales development results are not concentrated in a small number of teams.

Drive Pipeline

  • Own demand-trigger strategy. Ensure managers and their teams track HSR second requests, major litigation filings, and regulatory investigations, and refine KLD’s capture framework based on what converts.

  • Own qualification standards enterprise-wide. Require every opportunity across every segment to meet MEDDPICC criteria before handoff to an Account Executive, protecting pipeline coverage accuracy at scale.

  • Expand named accounts and the installed base across segments. Within territory rules of engagement, direct managers and their teams to multi-thread stakeholders (General Counsel’s office, litigation support, procurement) and to surface Nebula and AI Case Explorer attach opportunities with Sales and Client Solutions.

  • Own law firm channel strategy. Set the strategy for engagement with firms eligible for KLD’s matter demand-generation incentive programs, track participation across the portfolio, and surface referral-ready relationships to senior sales leadership.

Forecasting, Reporting, and Process Ownership

  • Forecast SDR-sourced pipeline across segments. Consolidate forecasts of meetings, qualified opportunities, and expected conversion from each manager; flag gaps early to the VP, Revenue Operations and Sales Leadership; and own corrective action.

  • Report on function performance. Partner with Sales Operations on Salesforce dashboards covering activity, stage conversion, handoff acceptance, qualification quality, and sourced pipeline across every segment, and present insights and recommendations to senior sales leadership in recurring business reviews.

  • Own SDR strategy and process. Partner with Sales Operations on lead routing, handoff criteria, SLAs with Account Executives, qualification standards, and territory rules. Own the SDR playbook, direct managers' adherence audits, and refine the playbook based on performance data.

  • Uphold data quality and drive change. Partner with Sales Operations to set CRM hygiene standards enterprise-wide, direct managers to audit adherence, roll out workflow and tooling changes (Salesforce, ZoomInfo, engagement platforms), and use conversion data to inform quotas, territories, and headcount planning across the function.

  • Partner across functions and influence senior stakeholders. Work with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Regional Sales Leadership, Account Executives, Client Solutions, and Marketing leadership on coverage, handoff, feedback loops, and campaigns, representing the sales development function in cross-functional and executive planning.

  • Own the team budget. Plan, manage, and track spend against approved targets for the sales development function.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every team, across every segment, consistently delivers pipeline and closed-won opportunities

  • MEDDPICC-qualification rate and handoff acceptance at or above 80% enterprise-wide, not just meeting volume

  • Growth in multi-threaded contacts and documented Nebula / AI Case Explorer attach opportunities

  • Tracked, active law firm relationships in matter demand-generation programs

  • Consolidated SDR forecast accuracy within ±10% across all segments, with timely, accurate reporting and CRM data quality at 90% completeness on required fields

  • A fully staffed, well-ramped sales development organization — managers and SDRs alike — with strong engagement, low attrition, and clear progression into Account Executive, management, and other senior roles

  • Spend within the approved team budget

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of sales development, business development, or sales experience, including 5+ years managing people managers or leading multiple quota-carrying teams

  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding pipeline and team targets across multiple teams or segments, and of hiring, developing, and retaining both individual contributors and managers

  • Experience building forecasts and performance reports from Salesforce (or a comparable CRM) and defining and enforcing sales processes such as lead routing and handoffs across multiple teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to engage and influence legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate litigation, regulatory, and M&A signals into organizational strategy

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

  • Experience building or scaling a sales development organization across multiple teams or segments, including structure, hiring plan, processes, metrics, and onboarding

  • Background in legal technology, eDiscovery, or complex B2B/enterprise software, including exposure to corporate legal departments or law firms

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and/or Challenger Sale, with experience coaching managers and sellers to apply them at scale

  • Experience in or alongside Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with dashboarding skills and signal-based prospecting or sales engagement tools

MBA, JD, or equivalent qualification

Our Mission & Values

Our Mission: We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

These four values guide how we operate, make decisions, and work together every day.

  • Client is Always in the Room - We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

  • Own the Outcome - We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients, and each other.

  • Better Every Day - We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

  • Deliver Results Together - We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

KLDiscovery is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, discipline, and termination. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and experience.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING FOR KLD (ALL LOCATIONS)

At KLD, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that when our employees feel supported, valued, and empowered, they can thrive both personally and professionally. That’s why we’re committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can grow your career, make meaningful contributions, and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

Our competitive benefits and programs are designed to support your well-being and success. Depending on your location, these may include comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement and financial programs, paid time off and leave options, employee assistance resources, and professional development opportunities.

We also embrace flexibility, offering remote work opportunities for most employees to support work-life balance while keeping our teams connected and collaborative. Certain roles may require an office-based or hybrid schedule based on business and operational needs.

Wherever you’re located, you’ll be part of a global team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and celebrates your success.

Benefits and eligibility vary by country, location, employment status, and applicable plan or program requirements.

raw.description:
Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release)

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Required Skills:

  • Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)

  • Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM)

  • Nanoparticle Sizing

  • Particle Size Distribution

  • Quality Control

  • Lot Release

  • Nanomaterials

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity centers on thorough nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release qualifications using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). The engagement emphasizes independent expert analysis - including manual image thresholding, calibration, and morphology assessments - without reliance on automated or AI-powered tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential to document findings, interpret complex micrographs, and convey critical decisions to project stakeholders.

Scope of Work:

  • Manually analyze and interpret TEM and SEM micrographs for nanoparticle sizing and morphological assessment

  • Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with rigorous attention to accuracy and reproducibility

  • Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards

  • Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification

  • Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data

  • Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria

  • Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation

  • Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies

  • Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration

  • Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools

  • Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus
