The Digital Forensics Engagement Manager (“EM”) works as a specialty function within Advisory Digital Forensics (DF) reporting directly into the Director.

Digital Forensics Engagement Managers assist with the management of cases by driving work through various operational workflows internally within the department and externally in collaboration with other departments. This includes creating work orders for tasks associated with shipping, resource assignments, and data intake to kick off the fundamental evidence handling steps for further downstream forensic analysis and/or ESI processing, culling, review, and production.

This role is responsible for developing project and client workflow standards, managing to a case or client budget, providing a consultative approach to problem solving, and identifying critical paths to completing projects with a focus on reducing costs, increasing speed of delivery and the use of innovate technology to exceed client expectations.

Digital Forensic EMs are expected to facilitate Lighthouse’s goal of maintaining a high level of client satisfaction, to ensure client facing error rates are kept below industry and Lighthouse standards, and to ensure delivery deadlines are consistently met. Success relies heavily on the ability to work effectively as a member of a team, to be flexible, and to manage multiple tasks across multiple cases at the direction of clients, account managers, full-service PMs, and the DF Director.

What will this person do?

  • Have a good understanding of eDiscovery, digital forensics, market competitors, and the tools used to support the industry.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of Lighthouse workflows, critical paths needed to progress work through the system and tools used by Lighthouse to manage workflows.
  • Manage client projects as designated by client stakeholders, account managers, full-service PMs, and the DF Director.

  • Lighthouse Workflows: Manage work through Lighthouse workflows, internal tools and documentation to effectively complete tasks and have the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment – 25%.
  • Communication Skills: Effectively transmit information via written (email and forms based formats such as SOWs) and verbal communications to convey instructions, identify issues and propose solutions to internal and external stakeholders – 25%.
  • Project Management Skills: Successfully manage client relationships and execute projects to completion to deepen Lighthouse relationships to ensure repeat work and increased share of clients’ total spend and to gain clients’ trust as a consultant – 25%.
  • Consistently achieve Digital Forensics billability expectations of 4.3 billable hours per working day (approximately 54% utilization), measured over time to account for normal fluctuations in client demand and PTO.
  • Strong project management skills including the ability to interpret a variety of instructions provided in written or oral form.
  • Work within timelines and budget parameters.
  • Assure quality, accuracy and timeliness of all deliverables.
  • Ability to delegate tasks to appropriate team members.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and the ability to multitask.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to handle a changing and growing workload.
  • Ability to foster positive and professional relationships at all levels internally and externally.
  • Strong analytical and logical skills.
  • Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of stakeholder demands.
  • Effective written and oral communication skills including having the ability to deal with difficult situations and manage conflicts to successful resolutions
  • 4+ years of work experience with at least two years of eDiscovery and digital forensics experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus).
  • PMP certification a plus.
  • Management experience a plus.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.

Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.

Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!

As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. Lighthouse offers a comprehensive quality benefits package including, medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match.  Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine, and other wellness plans.  We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days.  Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.

This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.

raw.description:
Company Overview

PharmaLogic is a leading and rapidly growing provider of SPECT and PET radiopharmaceutical solutions and contract development and manufacturing services. With radiopharmacies across North America, we are committed to expanding the power of radiopharmaceutical technology and delivering transformative diagnostic and therapeutic agents to patients—from bench to bedside.

PharmaLogic offers an exceptional opportunity for an experienced and commercially minded General Counsel to join our dynamic, results-oriented organization.

Position Summary

The General Counsel will serve as PharmaLogic’s senior legal advisor and a strategic partner to the leadership team. This individual will manage a broad and multifaceted portfolio of legal matters, with particular emphasis on commercial contracting, complex negotiations, intellectual property, litigation, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management.

Operating in a fast-paced and highly regulated environment, the General Counsel must be a pragmatic, hands-on business partner who enables the organization to move with agility and speed while appropriately identifying, balancing, and mitigating legal and regulatory risk. The successful candidate will provide practical, solutions-oriented counsel that supports business growth, operational execution, and sound decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted legal and strategic advisor to the Leadership Team and other senior business leaders on a broad range of commercial, operational, regulatory, and corporate matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of complex commercial agreements, including customer, supplier, manufacturing, licensing, confidentiality, technology, consulting, and strategic partnership agreements.
  • Develop practical contracting strategies and processes that improve speed, consistency, accountability, and business outcomes while maintaining appropriate legal protections.
  • Advise the business on intellectual property strategy, protection, licensing, ownership, confidentiality, trade secrets, and related commercial considerations.
  • Direct litigation, investigations, claims, and dispute-resolution matters, including the selection, management, and oversight of outside counsel.
  • Identify and evaluate legal and regulatory risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations that balance risk mitigation with the company’s commercial and operational priorities.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations, as well as requirements applicable to pharmaceutical, radiopharmaceutical, pharmacy, manufacturing, and GMP-regulated operations.
  • Partner closely with Quality, Regulatory, Compliance, Operations, Commercial, Human Resources, Finance, and other functions to support business initiatives and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Provide legal support for corporate governance, strategic transactions, financing activities, mergers and acquisitions, and other enterprise initiatives, as applicable.
  • Advise on employment, organizational, and workplace matters in partnership with Human Resources and external employment counsel, as appropriate.
  • Establish and maintain effective legal policies, controls, templates, playbooks, and training programs that strengthen compliance and enable efficient decision-making.
  • Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments and proactively advise leadership regarding potential business impact and required actions.
  • Manage the legal function, including its budget and the effective use of internal resources, outside counsel, and other legal service providers.
  • Build and develop a high-performing legal team capable of supporting a growing, complex, and highly regulated business.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive legal experience, including substantial in-house corporate experience and demonstrated responsibility for complex commercial and regulatory matters.
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial contracts and resolving complex business issues.
  • Demonstrated experience managing intellectual property matters, litigation, investigations, and outside counsel.
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance, employment law, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, radiopharmaceutical, biotechnology, CDMO, pharmacy, healthcare, or other highly regulated manufacturing operations strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of GMP requirements and the federal, state, and local regulatory frameworks affecting regulated pharmaceutical and manufacturing businesses strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to translate complex legal issues into concise, practical, and commercially relevant guidance.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to distinguish between material enterprise risks and issues that can be addressed through pragmatic business solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, make timely decisions, and deliver results in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional negotiation, drafting, communication, and relationship-management skills.
  • High ethical standards, integrity, discretion, and accountability.
  • Leadership experience managing legal professionals and external legal resources preferred.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be:

  • Commercially oriented and focused on enabling the business to achieve results.
  • Agile, responsive, and comfortable operating with speed and appropriate urgency.
  • A pragmatic problem-solver who presents viable solutions, not only legal risks.
  • Skilled at balancing business objectives, regulatory obligations, and enterprise risk.
  • Collaborative and capable of building credibility across executive, commercial, operational, technical, and compliance functions.
  • Hands-on and willing to engage directly in detailed legal work when needed.

Equal Employment Opportunity

PharmaLogic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Join our winning team and build a fulfilling career with PharmaLogic by applying today.

Under the supervision of Project Management, the Project Engineer’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to, development of pre-work and post work submittal packages, processing, validating and compiling cable test reports, drafting and processing RFIs, preparing change order requests, verifying field conditions against design documents, ensuring working sets of drawings and specifications are kept up-to-date, maintaining redline / as-built drawing sets and keeping project records appropriately filed. The most critical responsibility of this key role is communication. The Project Engineer must ensure that the entirety of the extended Project Team is always up to date.

What You Will Do:

  • Safety is our Priority. Follow Safe Work Practices that conform with the Company’s Safety Program and client worksite policies ensuring that every person on the team Stays Accident Free Every-day.
  • Promote company Core Values to foster and safeguard Company culture.
  • Participates in the RFP processes, completing a detailed review of plans, specifications, and entirety of bid package.
  • Provide close support to the Project Manager and/or Senior Project Manager.
  • Evaluate and continually suggest improvements to processes used by Project Delivery Teams to effectively meet customer requirements and expectations.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop colleagues.
  • Interact with the customer to validate our understanding of expectations before, during, and after project completion.
  • Aid in providing close support and oversight for our subcontractors.
  • Leads field validation of telecom design, proactively identifying conflicts or gaps and collaborating with CM, PM, and customer for resolution thru the RFI process.
  • Manage project review process with particular emphasis on constructability, value engineering options and design discrepancies / clashes.
  • Owns the implementation and oversight of electronic tracking systems and custom dashboards to drive real-time visibility into task progress, crew productivity, and issue resolution.
  • Daily/weekly reporting, issue escalation, and coordination with project managers and general contractors.
  • Proactively and systematically communicate challenges, risks, and successes.
  • Coordination with Project Superintendent(s) to understand and assess installation methods, labor needs, and manpower forecasts.
  • Support QA/QC by ensuring adherence to the Quality Control plans and process.
  • Ensure that all downstream team members are meeting deadlines on assigned tasks.
  • Reviews contracts, work orders and purchase orders to fully understand contractual requirements and provisions, and to ensure scope of work is in alignment with associated estimate and respective contract documents.
  • Cultivate and maintain customer relationships.
  • Work with the field operations team to ensure proper materials and equipment are available.
  • Coordinates with customer for acceptance and signoff.
  • Demonstrates ownership of the change management process—actively identifies scope impacts, initiates timely communication with stakeholders, and drives resolution to maintain schedule and project alignment.
  • Partners closely with QA/QC teams. Regularly reviews and validates test results (OTDR, Power Meter, etc.)
  • Maintains up to date redlines throughout the build lifecycle
  • Leads the preparation of closeout documentation, ensuring timely, organized, and customer-ready submittals.

Needs for Success:

  • Must be proficient and well-practiced in leveraging information and data in making informed decisions.
  • Extensive knowledge of Safety protocols, processes and procedures.
  • Deep understanding of industry specific estimating and engineering best practices.
  • Ability to identify change events.
  • Knowledge of various construction technology platforms, quality, and safety standards.
  • Ability to understand and develop project schedules.
  • Demonstrated professionalism and ability to interact effectively with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others.
  • Ability to work under time constraints and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude.
  • Strong oral and written communication and organizational skills, including excellent customer service skills.
  • Disciplined, detail oriented, organized, and self-driven.
  • Demonstrated skill in organizing resources and establishing priorities.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to mentor junior field staff, lead site walks, and represent the telecom discipline in cross functional meetings.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence without direct authority.
  • Proficient in using a computer and business / industry applications - Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel,
  • PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Bluebeam, Procore, Textura and others.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor’s Degree Construction Management, Engineering or other related discipline. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Minimum of 5+ years’ experience in the construction industry in a similar role. Experience with large, structured cabling projects and/or data center construction projects highly preferred
    Preferred professional certifications:
    • OSHA-30 Hour certification (if not certified at time of hire, certifications must be obtained within first six (6) months of employment)
    • BICSI TECH

Supervisory Responsibility:

This position will not have direct reports.

Work Location and Travel: Remote United States, with up to 50% travel to various client sites.

Note: This job description outlines the general nature of the responsibilities and duties executed by this position. Other responsibilities and duties may be assigned as reasonably needed or required.

We Are:

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


You Are:

A seasoned SAP data migration leader who thinks in blueprints and delivers at scale. You have the architectural vision to design enterprise-grade migration strategies and the hands-on depth to back it up. Whether you're defining migration frameworks for a global S/4HANA greenfield, leading complex brownfield conversions, or overseeing multi-wave data cutovers across heterogeneous landscapes, you bring the technical authority and executive presence to drive success. You are a trusted advisor to client leadership and a force multiplier for delivery teams—equally comfortable whiteboarding migration architecture and rolling up your sleeves to solve a stubborn data quality issue.


The Work:

  • Architect end-to-end SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA transformation programs, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective data transition (SDT) scenarios.
  • Define migration methodology, tooling selection, and governance frameworks across large-scale, multi-wave data migration programs.
  • Lead the design of data migration objects, business rules, transformation logic, and cutover sequencing across functional domains (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, HCM, etc.).
  • Oversee and mentor a team of data migration consultants and developers, ensuring quality and consistency across workstreams.
  • Drive engagement with client data owners, functional leads, and IT stakeholders to align on data quality standards, cleansing strategies, and sign-off processes.
  • Govern data migration tool configuration and usage (SAP LTMC/LTMOM, BODS, SLT, Syniti, or equivalent) and ensure adherence to migration architecture standards.
  • Lead migration rehearsals, mock cutovers, and go-live execution, including risk identification and real-time issue resolution.
  • Contribute to proposal development, client presentations, and practice-building activities including methodology development and capability uplift.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

What you Need:

  • Minimum of 8 years of SAP experience with at least 5 years in a lead data migration architect or data migration program lead role.
  • Minimum of 4 full end-to-end SAP data migration implementations, with at least 2 involving S/4HANA (greenfield or brownfield/system conversion).
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience leading or architecting migrations using SAP-native tooling such as LTMC/LTMOM, SAP BODS, SAP SLT, or comparable enterprise migration platforms.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience managing cross-functional delivery teams in a program or workstream lead capacity.
  • Experience supporting the CMT Industry and/or clients (specifically semi-conductors)
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent (12 years) work experience (If an Associate's Degree, then 6 years of work experience required).

Bonus Points If:

  • You have a SAP Certified Professional in SAP S/4HANA System Conversion or Migration, or equivalent SAP certification.
  • You have experience with Syniti Data Replication, SNP CrystalBridge, or Natuvion DPP for complex landscape transformation scenarios.
  • You have familiarity with data governance and master data management (MDM) frameworks (SAP MDG or equivalent) in the context of migration programs.
  • You have exposure to cloud migration scenarios involving SAP on AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure.
  • You have prior consulting experience at a Big 4, global systems integrator, or SAP Partner organization.

raw.description:
The Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialist II(CDI) is responsible for utilizing independent clinical judgement in facilitating the integrity, overall quality, accuracy, and completeness of provider-based clinical documentation in the medical record. This position is responsible for collaborating with healthcare providers to ensure the documentation in the medical record accurately reflects the severity of illness and risk of mortality of the patient. The CDI Specialist assesses the clinical documentation through extensive reviews of the medical record, interaction with all members of the healthcare team and the Healthcare Information Management (HIM) Coding team to ensure appropriate coding and Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) assignment for the level of services rendered to the patient and to ensure that the clinical information utilized in profiling and reporting outcomes is complete and accurate.

raw.description:
The Consolidations Senior Advanced Accountant is responsible for helping to lead the company's global consolidation function. This position will independently own significant elements of the monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation process and help ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP, SEC, and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements. The role will partner across the organization to resolve complex consolidation matters, improve processes, and maintain the integrity of the Company’s financial information. The successful candidate will be a detail oriented, hands-on subject-matter expert, with a continuous improvement mindset. Successful candidate will be self-motivated, accountable for the review and overall quality of the team's work product, and who enjoys working in a collaborative environment.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Independently own and execute significant consolidation activities, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, equity roll forwards, topside entries, and other complex consolidation adjustments.

  • Review journal entries, account analyses, consolidation reports, and supporting documentations prepared by team members; identify issues, provide direction, and drive timely resolution.

  • Monitor the consolidation close calendar, coordinate dependencies across teams, establish timelines and deliverables, escalate risks, and help ensure milestones are achieved.

  • Prepare and review consolidated financial results, including statement of cash flow, for accuracy, completeness, unusual trends, and consistency with underlying business activity; communicate findings and recommended actions to management.

  • Aide in maintaining and validating HFM consolidation structures and processes, including entity hierarchies, ownership structures, chart-of-accounts mappings, translation settings, consolidation rules, journals, and reporting outputs.
  • Alongside Consolidations Sr. Manager, Co- Lead compliance with SEC, US GAAP and Sarbanes Oxley regulations
  • Alongside Consolidation Sr. Manager, Co-Lead when providing information to other departments, management and/or external auditors
  • Evaluate business situations and generate ideas for solutions; analyzes the potential effect or impact of each solution; selects appropriate solutions driving continuous improvement.

  • Prepare and review consolidated financial information, supporting schedules, and financial statement footnote documentation used in Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K, earnings materials, and management reporting

  • Mentor more junior team members

Core HFM Duties

Financial Consolidation

  • Support management of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation processes

  • Execute and review intercompany eliminations

  • Perform foreign currency translation and CTA analysis

  • Process consolidation adjustments and top-side journal entries

  • Assist with maintaining ownership structures and entity hierarchies

  • Analyze consolidated financial results and variances

Reporting & Smart View

  • Develop and maintain Smart View reports

  • Perform ad hoc analysis and data extraction

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Investigate consolidation discrepancies

  • Research out-of-balance intercompany accounts

  • Resolve foreign exchange translation issues

Core FDMEE Duties

Data Integration Management

  • Support the data movement from ERP systems into HFM/EPM applications

  • Support the execution of Importing, Validating, Exporting, and Loading processes

Mapping and Data Governance

  • Review mapping changes related to chart of accounts updates

  • Understand the impact of mapping changes on financial reporting

Financial Reconciliation

  • Reconcile ERP balances to HFM results

  • Help analyze and resolve data integrity issues

Month-End Close Support

  • Assist with monitoring load schedules and close dependencies

Assist with managing data submission timelines across business units

YOU MUST HAVE:

  • 6+ years of experience in accounting or financial related positions.
  • 4+ years of experience in the consolidation processes & U.S. GAAP
  • Working experience in financial reporting software (e.g.,Hyperion , expert level preferred-HFM, Workiva, Microsoft suite).

WE VALUE:

  • A mix of public accounting and industry experience.
  • Experience in multinational public company environment, preferably in a global organization.
  • Working knowledge of reporting process related to eliminations, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency transactions, topside entries.
  • Working knowledge of financial systems/applications (e.g., Hyperion, HFM, Workiva).
  • Demonstrated skills in financial analysis and communication/business writing.
  • Ability to adapt to changing environments and think creatively.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage tasks by priority.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Own processes related to the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close periods.
  • Opportunity to leave a legacy through identification and implementation of continuous process improvements.
  • Leadership coaching and development opportunities to ensure you are set up for success and prepared for the next step in your career.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our reporting ecosystem by leveraging AI and automated workflows to modernize our standard procedures.
  • Be seen and heard with encouragement and empowerment to make decisions.
  • Be your AUTHENTIC self.
  • Leverage your expertise to build and improve Resideo' s culture and processes.

raw.title: Litigation Claims Examiner
raw.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled BI-LIT Claims Examiner to manage litigated files and attend trials, conferences, mediations, and arbitrations. The successful candidate will:

  • Investigate and gather all necessary information and documentation related to claims
  • Evaluate liability and damages
  • Negotiate and settle claims
  • Manage litigation cases related to auto claims disputes

The BI-LIT Claims Examiner will also be responsible for maintaining electronic files, analyzing defense counsel's performance, and regularly reporting to the Claims Manager. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate adjuster who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. You can find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the insured’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.
  • Curious. You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.
  • Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)
  • And did we mention, a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

What we need

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  • Managing legal aspects of litigated cases, including evaluation of legal process and expenses
  • Analyzing and reviewing auto insurance claims to identify areas of dispute, investigating and gathering all necessary information and documentation related to the claim, evaluating liability and damages related to the claim, and negotiating and settling claims with opposing parties or their insurance providers
  • Managing litigation cases related to auto claims disputes, attending mediations, arbitrations, and court hearings as necessary, and communicating regularly with clients, claims adjusters, attorneys, and other stakeholders
  • Collaborating with defense counsel, claims counsel, and litigation claims management for strategic planning, including developing and maintaining positive working relationships with approved defense firms and other vendors in the industry
  • Reviewing legal documents and ensuring compliance with initial suit-handling plan of action
  • Serving as corporate representative for discovery review and depositions, and appearing as Corporate Representative at depositions and trials when needed
  • Analyzing policy language and reaching appropriate coverage decisions, drafting frequent and complex coverage correspondence, and proactively managing primarily litigated claim files from inception to closure
  • Directing and controlling the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters
  • Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • 10+ years of claim handling experience, with 5+ of those years handling a pending of >60% in litigation
  • Transportation litigation (rideshare, auto, trucking, etc) is preferred but those with personal lines experience should still apply if they meet all other requirements.
  • You are not intimidated by an attorney, even if you are not one! You are the driver of the litigation strategy for any particular claim. You manage the discovery in the order and timing of events and hold attorney accountable
  • Understand transportation coverages. Understand contractual risk transfer and additional insured forms
  • You have strong medical knowledge
  • You have a sense of urgency and understanding of how to manage time-sensitive demands
  • Ability and willingness to communicate both on the phone and in written form in a prompt, courteous, and professional manner
  • Strong analytical and negotiation skills. You will conduct your own negotiations directly with opposing counsel
  • Knowledge of multiple state statutes, including good faith claim handling practices, regulations, and guidelines
  • Ability to professionally collaborate with all stakeholders in a claim
  • Attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work

As a senior analyst in a well-funded, growth Series C start-up, you will be defining our growth potential for years to come. You will be an integral part of Reserv’s data team, working with our customers to deliver high-fidelity data and insights.

For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python, SQL, and Excel skills. You should be curious about how claims work and how our systems process them. You’ll also need the ability to interface with customers from both technical and non-technical backgrounds, and to work independently while collaborating closely with our engineering and operations teams.   • A passion for building intuitive technology and a thirst for learning
  • Able to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

  • We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused Commercial Transportation Resolution Specialists to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for communicating with customers on the phone, educating and helping the customer work through their claim to the best possible outcome. This role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim. The claims you will handle will be commercial transportation (interstate trucking) related.

    The ideal candidate has a willingness to work through and design process that supports the quickest claim resolution with the best outcome.

    Resolution Specialists are:
  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. Excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate specialists who care about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. Exercises empathy and patience towards everyone interacted with.
  • Sense of urgency - AT ALL TIMES. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. Finding the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the client’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational. Working toward a win/win claim resolution.
  • Curious. Wanting to know the whole story so the right decisions are made early and take action to prompt a quick resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. Not just wishing things were done differently but taking the appropriate actions to ensure it.
  • Communicative. Professional written and oral communication with all parties to a claim.
  • And did we mention a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous, and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, texts, and/or emails in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Gather necessary information from customers to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and educate them on the claims process and next steps.
  • Manage an inventory of claims, establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim.
  • Work with the APD team on the handling of property damage claims.
  • Recognize recovery opportunities with regard to subrogation and salvage, as well as total loss.
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority.
  • Provide input to continuously develop claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements.
  • Know the claims inside and out and ensure outside investigative service providers, including independent appraisers and defense counsel, are guided based on what we need to move the file to a quick and appropriate resolution. All the while keeping our clients updated where needed.
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of claims statutes, recent/updated court decisions impacting the claims function, current internal guidelines, and policy changes and modifications.

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience concentrated in commercial transportation (interstate trucking) claims adjusting, ideally with:
      • Third-party bodily injury, including catastrophic losses
      • UM/UIM bodily injury
      • Litigation experience
      • MCS90 and its state equivalents
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state-required testing.

Director, Strategic Pricing & Analytics

Remote

Company Overview: AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Director, Strategic Pricing & Analytics serves as a key business partner to Health Plan Relations (HPR), Revenue Cycle Management, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership, leading the organization's payer contract modeling, chargemaster governance, and price transparency analytics functions. This role provides financial and operational insights that support payer negotiations, pricing decisions, reimbursement optimization, and integration activities. The Director is responsible for establishing analytical standards, ensuring data integrity, developing team capabilities, and advancing the organization's pricing and reimbursement analytics programs.

Work Schedule: Remote First

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead payer contract modeling activities, directing the development, maintenance, and governance of reimbursement models while ensuring consistency, accuracy, scalability, and actionable insights across all markets and service lines.
  • Serve as a player-coach by remaining actively engaged in complex reimbursement modeling, financial analysis, and payer negotiation support while mentoring and developing team members in modeling methodologies and analytical best practices.
  • Direct chargemaster development, maintenance, and pricing governance to support revenue integrity, compliance, and reimbursement optimization.
  • Partner with departmental leadership to develop and enhance price transparency reporting, dashboards, and market intelligence capabilities.
  • Oversee the aggregation, validation, and interpretation of pricing and reimbursement data to support payer negotiations, market assessments, and executive decision-making.
  • Lead and direct analytics staff to meet business needs that support achieving department and organizational goals and objectives.
  • Establish and maintain standards, controls, and governance processes that ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of payer modeling, reimbursement analytics, chargemaster management, and price transparency reporting.
  • Represent HPR on integration committees associated with acquisitions, de novo centers, mergers, and center consolidations, providing reimbursement, pricing, chargemaster, and payer contract expertise to support successful integrations.
  • Lead ad hoc reimbursement analyses and other analytical projects requested by leadership to support business planning and operational initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement through talent development, process optimization, reporting enhancements, and advancement of analytical tools and technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.

    • Expertise in healthcare industry, managed care contracts, reimbursement methodologies, and pricing strategies.
    • Demonstrated ability to build and audit sophisticated financial models, analyze large healthcare datasets, develop reporting solutions, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
    • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess reimbursement, pricing, and contracting scenarios and provide sound business recommendations.
    • Fluency in Microsoft Office applications with advanced Excel skills required; strong Microsoft Office, Access, relational databases, and reporting tools a plus.
    • Demonstrated ability to design, develop, and implement routine and custom reporting.
    • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with C-suite and executive leadership (i.e., packaging and presenting nuanced and detailed information, fielding and responding to questions across the organization, etc.).
    • Excellence in delivering projects on time and with the desired results through a structured project management (e.g., time, team, work-stream management) approach.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Finance, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Advanced degree (MBA, MHA, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in health care or health plan analytics.
  • Working knowledge of ambulatory surgery payer contract methodologies.
  • Expertise in Excel-based modeling, analysis, financial reporting or data analytics required.
  • Experience leading a team to achieve business objectives.

At AMSURG, our values define who we are and how we serve our patients, partners, and each other. As a national leader in ambulatory surgery, we are committed to a culture of excellence, integrity, teamwork and caring deeply. Our values guide every decision, ensuring we continue to elevate healthcare and provide the highest quality care.
These guiding principles are the foundation of our culture and a guide to how we collaborate, innovate, and make a difference every day.

  • Care Deeply for those around us.
  • Cultivate Integrity to build trust.
  • Champion Excellence for continuous improvement
  • Celebrate Teamwork every step to the way.

To ensure we retain and invest in great people, AMSURG provides its employees with the benefits, recognition, training, and opportunities needed for professional growth. Our wide range of health and welfare benefits allow you to choose the right coverage for you and your family. AMSURG offers a variety of health and welfare benefit options to help protect your health and promote your wellbeing. Benefits offered include but are not limited to: Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Healthcare FSA, Dependent Care FSA, Limited Healthcare FSA, FSAs for Transportation and Parking & HSAs, and a matching 401(K) Plan.

Paid Time Off:

  • Cross Functional Service Delivery: Ensure reliable and efficient delivery of cross functional services across IT Delivery Business Applications. Define and continuously improve common processes, governance and delivery standards.

  • Partner and Vendor Management: Manage strategic delivery partners and external resources, ensuring alignment with agreed objectives, performance expectations, quality standards and commercial commitments.
  • Risk and Quality Management: Proactively identify and manage operational and delivery risks. Ensure that services and deliverables meet agreed quality, compliance and business requirements.
  • Technology Enablement: Monitor relevant technology developments and promote the appropriate use of workflow automation, analytics, artificial intelligence and agentic capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and quality.

Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in consulting, project delivery or application operations, with a focus on industrialized service delivery.
  • IT delivery leadership: Proven experience in global IT service delivery and application operations across SAP and non-SAP environments.
  • Consulting experience: A strong consulting background, with the ability to assess complex challenges, develop practical recommendations and translate strategy into measurable results.
  • Automation and innovation:Experience identifying and implementing workflow automation, analytics and AI opportunities to improve efficiency and service quality.
  • Performance management: Ability to establish meaningful KPIs, dashboards and actionable insights that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Operational excellence: A track record of standardising processes, strengthening governance and stabilising business-critical application services.
  • Stakeholder and partner management: Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience aligning senior stakeholders, cross-functional teams and strategic delivery partners.
  • Change leadership: Ability to build engagement, challenge established ways of working and embed sustainable improvements across a global organisation.
  • MedTech and regulated environments: Experience in medical technology, life sciences or another regulated industry is highly desirable, with an understanding of quality and compliance requirements.

Education & Qualifications:

  • A bachelor's degree in business, information technology, or a related field. Advanced degrees or certifications are a plus.
  • ITIL 4, PRINCE2 or SAFe CSP certification is a plus.

Travel Requirements:

raw.title: Client Solutions Manager
raw.excerpt: Somewhere in your career, a client asked for something the platform didn't do out of the box.
raw.description:
Somewhere in your career, a client asked for something the platform didn't do out of the box. You didn't say no, and you didn't overpromise. You asked enough questions to find out what they actually needed, built a configuration that solved it, and showed them how to run it themselves. When it worked, it worked because you understood both the system and the person asking.

That's the kind of person we're looking for.

What We Do

Every school district in America runs on service. Parents need answers, teachers need support, IT teams need systems that work. Most districts cobble that together with disconnected tools, overwhelmed staff, and no real visibility into what's working.

Onflo built the platform that fixes that. Our unified service platform brings together customer service, help desk ticketing, call center operations, AI chat, and IT asset management, purpose-built for K-12 public education. When a district runs on Onflo, their staff spends less time firefighting and more time serving students and families.

You'll be the person who makes the platform do what each district needs it to do.

The Role

You'll own client solutioning for our district clients, post-implementation. When a district needs a custom workflow, a chatbot configured, a call center stood up, or a stubborn problem diagnosed, that lands with you. You'll run discovery to figure out what's really needed, build and validate the configuration, and train the district to use it. You'll scope expansion projects with Account Management and write the statements of work that delivery runs on. Small projects, you'll run end to end yourself. Larger ones, you'll scope cleanly and hand off to our Implementation team.

What you'll own

  • Solutioning for a book of district accounts: discovery, design, configuration, delivery
  • Platform customization: custom forms, workflows, chatbot and call center configuration
  • Advanced troubleshooting on escalated district issues
  • Scoping and statements of work for expansion projects, in partnership with Account Management
  • Training and webinars that leave districts more self-sufficient, not more dependent
  • Daily coordination with our India-based Client Care team, with clean written handoffs across time zones

Who Thrives Here

We'll be direct with you, because we think you'll appreciate it.

Onflo is a small, entrepreneurial team. We don't have a perfect playbook for everything. Priorities shift. This role sits between three teams (Account Management, Implementation, and Client Care) and the seams between them are yours to work. Some days that means a superintendent's cabinet in the morning and a webinar for front-office staff in the afternoon. Districts will ask for things the platform shouldn't do, and part of your job is saying so, with a better alternative attached.

The people who do their best work here genuinely like building things and teaching people to use them. They keep commitments without being chased. They push back on unworkable requests instead of quietly absorbing them. They write clearly enough that a colleague nine and a half time zones away can act without a call. And underneath it, they care about public schools and the families they serve.

If you want to advise from a distance and hand the building to someone else, this isn't your role. If you want to own the problem from "what do you need?" through "here's how it works," keep reading.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a post-sales technical client-facing role in B2B SaaS: technical account management, implementation, professional services, or similar
  • Hands-on platform configuration experience you personally performed: workflows, forms, integrations, or comparable
  • Experience scoping client projects and writing statements of work or equivalent
  • Experience designing and delivering client training, live and virtual
  • Able to explain the same solution to a district IT director and a school front-office team, and be understood by both
  • K-12 or public-sector experience is a plus, not a requirement; we'll teach you the industry if you bring the fundamentals

The right person reading this already knows if they're right for it. If that's you, apply.

Location: This is a remote position open to candidates residing anywhere in the United States. Expected travel for this role is 20%. #Li-remote

Expected Base Salary: $85,000 - $95,000 / year + Discretionary Bonus. Exact pay is based on experience, skills, market demand, and internal equity.

K12 Insight is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of backgrounds, beliefs, and experiences to be critical to our success and are passionate about creating a welcoming, supportive, and collaborative environment for all employees. All are encouraged to apply as we continue to grow a smart, hard-working, and diverse team who love working together to build something that matters. raw.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Senior Director, Pharmacy Solutions leads the strategy, adoption, and optimization of oncology drug management initiatives across The US Oncology Network. This role serves as a critical link between enterprise strategy and community oncology practice execution, helping practices navigate evolving clinical, financial, operational, and market dynamics while ensuring safe, sustainable adoption of oncology therapies.

This leader oversees a high-performing team of Pharmacy Solutions Directors responsible for strategic practice engagement, portfolio management, and performance optimization. Working closely with physician leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the GPO, Operations, Finance, Research, Analytics, Technology, Market Access, and Manufacturer Relations, the Senior Director aligns enterprise capabilities with practice needs to advance patient access, improve practice performance, and support long-term economic sustainability.

As a trusted advisor to both practices and enterprise leadership, this individual combines deep oncology expertise, drug economics knowledge, and operational leadership to drive strategic decision-making, strengthen Network readiness, and advance pharmacy growth initiatives across the Network.

The ideal candidate is a visible and influential oncology leader with a demonstrated ability to translate complex clinical, financial, and market insights into actionable strategies. They possess strong executive presence, lead through influence, and have a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in community oncology, specialty pharmacy, or healthcare strategy environments.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Drug Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Lead development and prioritization of Network drug strategy initiatives by integrating clinical evidence, physician perspectives, manufacturer pipeline intelligence, payer dynamics, reimbursement considerations, and practice economics.
  • Establish portfolio governance, prioritization frameworks, and performance measures to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of Pharmacy Solutions Directors.
  • Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and development opportunities to build organizational capability and future leaders.

Practice Strategy & Performance Optimization

  • Partner with Network practices to support adoption of strategic initiatives, optimize drug utilization strategies, and improve practice performance.
  • Serve as an executive sponsor for key practice relationships and strategic growth opportunities.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Collaborate with physician governance groups and enterprise stakeholders to align priorities, remove barriers, and drive enterprise-wide execution.
  • Lead complex, high-visibility initiatives that require alignment across multiple business functions.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Connect clinical, operational, and financial insights to identify opportunities, assess impact, and support informed decision-making.
  • Ensure strategic recommendations are supported by measurable outcomes and value realization.

Market Intelligence & Industry Engagement

  • Monitor emerging therapies, industry trends, payer landscapes, and reimbursement changes to inform Network strategy.
  • Represent the organization through professional associations, conferences, advisory boards, and industry forums.

Measures of Success

  • Successful delivery of a prioritized enterprise drug strategy portfolio with defined objectives, milestones, accountability, and measurable outcomes.
  • Increased Network readiness and adoption of strategic initiatives across practices.
  • Improved practice engagement, satisfaction, and overall performance outcomes.
  • Strong alignment between clinical and financial strategies resulting in measurable business impact.
  • High-performing Pharmacy Solutions team demonstrating engagement, accountability, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Effective governance processes supporting timely decision-making and enterprise execution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; equivalent experience considered.
  • Typically requires 13+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum 6+ years of leadership and Oncology experience managing and developing teams in complex healthcare environments.

Education

  • PharmD or equivalent pharmacy degree required.
  • Active pharmacist license in good standing required.
  • MBA, MHA, MS, or other advanced degree preferred.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 13+ years of progressive experience in oncology, specialty pharmacy, healthcare strategy, market access, practice operations, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of people leadership experience with demonstrated success building and developing high-performing teams.
  • Deep knowledge of oncology therapeutics, community oncology care models, manufacturer pipelines, reimbursement, payer dynamics, and drug economics.
  • Experience leading enterprise-level initiatives across matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect clinical and financial strategies to measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, executive communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Active participation in industry organizations, advisory boards, conferences, or professional networks preferred.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Executive Presence & Influencing Skills
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Change Leadership & Adoption Management
  • Talent Development & Team Building
  • Governance, Prioritization & Execution Excellence
  • Analytical Decision-Making & Problem Solving
  • Industry Insight & Learning Agility

Working Conditions

  • Remote opportunity within the United States, subject to company policy.
  • Up to 30% travel for practice engagement, leadership meetings, and industry events.

raw.description:
Equifax is where you can power your possible. If you want to achieve your true potential, chart new paths, develop new skills, collaborate with bright minds, and make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you.

A PrincipalCustomer Success Manager (PCSM) must be a proactive self-starter who maintains an owner’s mindset toward their client portfolio. The core of this role involves partnering closely with clients to identify and meet their specific business objectives, ensuring they derive maximum value from our solutions. Through this proactive support, a PCSM effectively drives customer satisfaction, product adoption, long-term retention, and revenue expansion.

Furthermore, managing banking clients requires a specialised skill set that extends beyond standard relationship management. Because banks operate in highly complex, heavily regulated environments with stringent security protocols and extended adoption cycles, it is vital that a candidate possesses a good understanding of these unique institutional challenges to be successful.

What you will do

  • Develop strong relationships with our clients by maintaining a high level of engagement, aligning business objectives, and providing raving fan service
  • Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions, client base, and best practices
  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the client, ensuring success and maximum value as they adopt a new platform/service
  • Educate clients on business value of solutions and application of best practices
  • Provide business insights through client value presentations, Quarterly Business Reviews, and other methods
  • Identify potential growth and upsell opportunities to expand revenue, engaging the Account Executive at the appropriate time to hand off the opportunity.
  • Assess customer health by monitoring product usage, reported issues, and other success metrics
  • Act as a liaison between internal COE teams to ensure customer needs are being met and to create solutions to client pain points; coordinating amongst technology, sales, marketing, finance, and product teams
  • Identify trends and relay feedback internally to appropriately address underlying issues
  • Provide clients full transparency on status of issues / requests from submission through resolution, working across teams and driving the escalation process as needed
  • Actively participate in the customer life cycle process, from prospect to renewal
  • Participate in CSM programme development and improvement activities
  • Facilitate customer account changes, product set up and billing research/corrections
  • Work with Sales and other Learning & Development teams to facilitate customer training as needed

What experience you need

  • Strong experience in a Customer Success, Account Management, or other Client-Facing role
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) required, or the equivalent years of industry experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve business and basic technical problems. Requirement for a foundational understanding of banking regulations (e.g., GDPR, FCA guidelines)
  • Ability to effectively manage daily client communications, including escalations and problem management situations
  • Banks are heavily siloed. A successful banking CSM must be adept at building consensus across multiple departments, including IT, Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and the actual business line users. Must be able to work autonomously and collaborate as part of a team
  • Change moves slowly in financial institutions due to necessary risk and compliance checks. The candidate needs exceptional patience and project management skills to keep momentum alive over a 12-to-18-month adoption process.
  • Ability to travel occasionally (up to 25% of the time)

What could set you apart

  • Possesses strong analytical skills, process improvement and project management capabilities a plus
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including formal as well as informal client and internal presentations
  • Exhibits confidence and is calm under pressure
  • Understand the end-to-end banking customer journey, from customer acquisition and loan origination to account management and collections.
  • A good working knowledge of financial regulations (such as FCA guidelines, GDPR, KYC/AML rules, and Fair Lending practices) to understand the constraints and pressures their clients face.

The Perks of being a Equifax Employee?

We offer a wide range of company supported benefits including contributory pension, life cover, income protection, healthcare, enhanced maternity and sick pay, 26 days holiday and a day off for your birthday, with the ability to buy and sell and free credit checks. We also offer flexible benefits ranging from cycle to work, discounted travel options, gym membership, dining and leisure discounts, financial & savings plans, mobile discounts plus much more!

We also support personal development and have a range of learning options including our global online learning platform and allow you to bring your whole self to work supported by our Inclusion and Diversity, Wellbeing and Employee Engagement forums.

Are you ready to power your possible? Apply today, and get started on a path toward an exciting new career at Equifax, where you can make a difference!

Ob Panne, Unfall oder Fahrzeugausfall: Bei Europ Assistance organisierst Du als Kundenberater Inbound (m/w/d) schnelle Hilfe für unsere Kund:innen. Du bist die erste Stimme, die Sicherheit gibt, und sorgst dafür, dass sie schnell wieder mobil sind. Kein Sales, sondern echter Service mit Verantwortung. Arbeite von überall in Deutschland aus 100 % remote. Wir bieten Dir maximale Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, Deinen Arbeitsalltag vollständig mobil zu gestalten.


Deine Aufgaben:
  • Du nimmst telefonische Kundenanliegen rund um Pannenhilfe, Abschleppservice oder Mietwagenorganisation sowie zur Haus- oder Familienversicherung an
  • Du koordinierst Hilfsmaßnahmen für internationale Kund:innen – vom Abschleppdienst bis zur Ersatzmobilität.
  • Du kommunizierst mit Versicherungen, Partnern und Dienstleistern und bearbeitest Rechnungen

das bringst du mit

  • Deine Erfahrung im Kundenservice ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Arbeitest du in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie, dem Tourismus, der Automobilbranche oder Versicherung, Call-Center-Branche dann bist du bei uns genau richtig
  • Für die Einarbeitung, Probezeitendgespräche und Teamevents bist Du bereit, einige Male nach Rostock zu reisen (Übernachtungs- und Reisekostenwerden unsererseits erstattet)
  • Du hast Freude am Telefonieren und daran, Menschen zu helfen.
  • Du hast ein organisatorisches Talent, bist zuverlässig und ein echter Teamplayer
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und flüssige Englischkenntnisse (B2-Niveau)
Vorerst ist die Tätigkeit auf zwei Jahre befristet und nur innerhalb Deutschlands zu besetzen (keine Tätigkeit aus dem Ausland). Unser Unternehmen wächst stark und bietet ausgezeichnete Chancen auf eine unbefristete Stelle. Die Einarbeitung findet zu Beginn für 3 Wochen am Standort Rostock statt. Wir übernehmen hierfür natürlich alle Kosten und du lernst weitere neue KollegenInnen kennen.

Wenn Du zudem über Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft verfügst, auf Basis einer 5-Tage-Woche im Schichtdienst (24/7, Nachtschichten sowie Wochenenden und Feiertage) zu arbeiten, möchten wir Dich gerne kennenlernen.
Deine Wünsche fließen in eine ausgewogene Schichtplanung mit ein. Für Deine Tätigkeit nach 20 Uhr sowie an Sonn- und Feiertagen erhältst Du lukrative steuer- und sozialabgabenfreie Schichtzulagen.

Die Gehaltsbandbreite für diese Position beträgt in Vollzeit, je nach Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation, 2.750 bis ca. 3.050 brutto im Monat (zuzüglich Nettozulagen durch Schichten).

Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

was wir dir bieten

  • Dein Start bei Redion: Wir wollen, dass Du Dich von Anfang an wohl fühlst und Du direkt mit dem Netzwerken starten kannst. Deshalb geht’s bei uns immer mit einer Onboarding-Veranstaltung los, während der Du und Deine neuen Kolleg*innen euch abteilungsübergreifend kennenlernen könnt. Danach geht’s weiter in Deinen Fachbereich – mit einer mehrwöchigen, individuellen Einarbeitung zu unseren Prozessen und Deinem individuellem Tagesgeschäft.
  • Mobiles Arbeiten deutschlandweit: Arbeite dort, wo es für Dich am besten passt. Du kannst Deine Tätigkeit deutschlandweit mobil ausüben oder an unserem Standort in München arbeiten. Selbstverständlich stellen wir Dir alle notwendigen technischen Arbeitsmittel zur Verfügung. Nach erfolgreicher Probezeit unterstützen wir Dich zusätzlich mit einer einjährigen Zulage für das mobile Arbeiten.
  • Du stehst auf Fitness? Auch das ist bei uns möglich! Durch unseren Kooperationspartner „EGYM“ bezuschussen wir Dir mit über 6500 Partner im Sport- und Wellnessnetzwerk und weit als mehr 2000 Onlinekurse zu Bewegung, Ernährung und Meditation deine Gesundheit.
  • Deutschlandticket: Bei uns hast du ab dem ersten Tag die Möglichkeit, das Ticket zu einem besonderen Vorzugspreis zu erhalten
  • Deine Weiterentwicklung: Wir wachsen in jeder Hinsicht- und wollen natürlich, dass Du mit uns wächst. Dabei unterstützen wir Dich in Form unserer digitalen Lernplattform und speziellen Weiterbildungen rund um Deinen Job.
  • Urlaubstage: Wo wir grade beim Thema Rahmenbedingungen sind – bei uns erwarten dich bei einer 5 Tage Woche 30 Tage Urlaub.
  • Für dein leibliches Wohl ist gesorgt: Egal ob Kaffee, Snacks oder Mittagessen. Schau einfach in unserer hauseigenen Münchner Kantine vorbei. Und das Beste: wir bezuschussen hier den Genuss!
  • Noch mehr Benefits: Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerparty, Teamevents, kostenfreie Mitarbeiterparkplätze (in München), Zugang zur Generali Kindertagesstätte (in München), der Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vergünstigte Versicherungsprodukte von der Generali bzw. Redion – unsere Liste ist lang. Da ist bestimmt auch für Dich etwas dabei!

dein recruiting kontakt

Irma Subasic nimmt sich gerne Zeit, um Deine Fragen persönlich zu beantworten.

+49 89 55 98 72 51

Es würde uns freuen, wenn Du Dich bewirbst (aktueller Lebenslauf und Arbeitszeugnisse) und dabei eine Gehaltsbandbreite sowie den nächstmöglichen Eintrittstermin angibst.

raw.description:
At Acxiom, our vision is to transform data into value for everyone. Our data services enable marketers to recognize, better understand, and deliver highly applicable messages to consumers across any available channel. Our solutions enable true people-based marketing with identity resolution and rich descriptive and predictive audience segmentation. We are seeking a Data Analyst with a versatile skill set to undertake data science and analytics supporting the development of next-generation products for Acxiom’s business.

As part of the Data Sciences & Analytics Team, you will work hands-on with innovative technologies to build scalable data products and solutions for our US and global businesses. Your responsibilities include evaluating potential new data partners, establishing quality control processes, monitoring data refreshes, supporting the build of a multi-sourced CPG data product, and QA the final product prior to release/update.

What you will do:

  • Research and develop an understanding of Acxiom products, tools, and processes
  • Assist with the validation and delivery of products or improvements
  • Prepare analysis datasets by appending data, deduping, loading data to analysis applications, and merging with other datasets
  • Perform queries on the data to discern data anomalies and quality audits to ensure the accuracy of the rules or statistical models
  • Assist with engineering, build teams, delivery and platform teams to ensure appropriate data delivery and presentation
  • Perform basic research/analysis which includes accuracy reports, cross-tabs, frequencies, data hygiene, correlations, data summarizations, and profiles reports or profile data
  • Collaborate with other data scientists and team leads to define project requirements including data sources, algorithms, and implementation
  • Offer ideas for product and/or process improvements such as automation related to focus area of work
  • Extract, load, and transform data as preparation for modeling. Build and maintain data mart solutions to support scored model outputs

What you will need:

  • Working knowledge or experience with one or more of the following tools: SQL, R, Python, Scala, Spark or similar programming language
  • 3-5 years experience with ETL, data transformation, data mart development, data source ingestion, data pipelining, data warehousing solutions
  • 3-5 years experience with cloud computing environments and/or certifications - Databricks and/or Snowflake is a plus.
  • Ability to demonstrate critical thinking and enthusiasm for translating data into actionable insight to generate consistently accurate and useful analysis and models
  • Ability to quality control production processes
  • Ability to develop dashboards or reporting for monitoring data performance and consistency.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative field (Applied Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science) or related degree programs and 3 years of relevant work experience
  • Ability to work independently when given detailed specification and instruction
  • Standout colleague, flexible, and creative
  • Attention to detail and time management delivering high quality work while meeting deadlines
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience Microsoft Office suite – especially Excel, Power Point, Word

What will set you apart:

  • Databricks data analyst certification and experience with CPG transaction level data
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Azure etc.) a plus
  • Experience in statistical modeling techniques to conduct forecasting and other predictive modeling services using R, Python, Scala, Spark/pySpark

We believe in building an awesome workplace where associates feel engaged and want to come to work every single day. It’s important to Acxiom that we invest in our culture and promote a healthy work-life balance, even when our associates are at work.

As a part of our team, you will join a fast-moving, dynamic, “get stuff done” culture we empower our people to do their jobs. You will always be guided to do what’s right, legally and morally for our customers. At Acxiom, we believe in exceptionalism- we intend to be the absolute best in everything we do
