raw.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Risk Automation & Intelligence leads the strategy and execution of the data, analytics and automation capabilities that the rest of the Technology Risk and Compliance function relies on to manage risk and demonstrate compliance effectively and efficiently. This is a senior leadership role accountable for the capability across GSK, spanning policy, process, automation and tooling, training and end-user experience for Technology Risk and Compliance capabilities and services.

About the team. Risk Automation and Intelligence is the engine room of the Risk and Compliance function's data and automation, operating as GSK's Risk Operations Centre. The team builds future-ready analytics, automation and intelligence that enable GSK to manage technology risk and compliance proactively and at scale.


Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


  • Set the enterprise vision and multi-year strategy for the data, analytics and automation capabilities that underpin Technology Risk and Compliance at GSK, and secure the investment to deliver it.
  • Lead the Risk Automation & Intelligence organisation, including leaders of teams, and own its capability plan.
  • Own the budget, vendor portfolio and headcount plan for the capability.
  • Represent the capability to the CISO, GSK Tech leadership, auditors and regulators.
  • Own GSK's Cyber Security Policies, ensuring they remain current, practical and aligned with the evolving threat, technology and regulatory landscape.
  • Own the Technology Risk and Compliance processes used across GSK, ensuring they are well-designed, consistently applied and continuously improved.
  • Own the integration between Technology Risk and Compliance and GSK's Enterprise Risk Programme, ensuring technology risk is represented accurately and consistently in enterprise risk reporting and governance.
  • Operate and evolve GSK's Risk Operations Centre model, bringing modern Risk Operations Centre concepts, continuous controls monitoring and quantitative risk analysis into how GSK manages technology risk and compliance.
  • Bring product management rigour to the roadmap for risk and compliance tooling, translating the needs of stakeholders at Director, VP and SVP level into prioritised features and releases.
  • Build and lead the capability that automates risk, control and compliance processes, including AI and intelligent automation, to replace manual effort with proactive, at-scale risk management.
  • Develop risk analytics, models and quantitative risk methods that help the business identify, evaluate and treat cyber risk, and that support prioritisation and inform resource and investment decisions for leadership, ExCom and the Board.
  • Develop performance analytics that measure the effectiveness and operational efficiency of the Technology Risk and Compliance programme itself, driving continuous improvement.
  • Own the data platform and pipelines underpinning risk intelligence, including the tooling used for Board-level Key Risk Indicators, issue and risk management, third-party cyber risk management and software development lifecycle compliance.
  • Own the GRC tooling strategy, including ServiceNow, ensuring the platforms used across GSK for risk and compliance management are modern, well-integrated and fit for purpose.
  • Bring fresh, innovative thinking to how GSK instruments and automates risk and compliance, challenging existing approaches to deliver superior outcomes with less manual effort.
  • Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Why You?
Basic Qualification
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience in risk analytics, automation or security data science.
  • Experience building AI and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Product management experience, including applying Agile delivery methods and translating stakeholder requirements into a prioritised roadmap.
  • Experience applying Lean Six Sigma or other process excellence methodologies.
  • Experience delivering data platforms and data pipelines.
  • Experience leading a technical capability.
  • Cyber security experience, including leading a global capability.
  • Experience managing people leaders across multiple geographies.
  • Experience managing a capability budget and vendor portfolio.
  • Experience with quantitative risk analysis and statistical methods.
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership or board-level audiences

Preferred Qualification
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Experience leading a data, analytics or automation capability.
  • Experience with cyber risk quantification methods and associated quantitative risk analysis techniques.
  • Familiarity with modern Risk Operations Centre (ROC) concepts and operating models.
  • Experience with continuous controls monitoring.
  • Familiarity with modern GRC platforms, especially ServiceNow.
  • Cloud data platform experience in Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Relevant certification such as CRISC, CISSP, cloud data or analytics certifications.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.

Typical tools and technologies: Python, SQL, Azure data stack, ServiceNow GRC, Power BI, automation, RPA and AI/intelligent automation tooling.

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

raw.description:
The Role:

Project Specialists provide administrative and programmatic support through all stages of the federal and state grant program lifecycle - pre-award review, project implementation, progress monitoring, and award closeout. Project Specialists are responsible for communicating expectations and requirements with project applicants, analyzing proposals and budgets, ensuring compliance with the established program requirements, and providing coordination between Local, State and Federal levels of government and other entities. This is a remote position. Travel requirements vary by program assignment. Some roles involve minimal travel, while others may require up to 50% in state travel to visit property sites, meet with applicants, provide program information, and support application completion.

While candidates from any U.S. location are welcome to apply, those based in the Southeastern United States (including Florida and Southern Georgia) may be especially well aligned with current geographical program needs.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Oversee the lifecycle of mitigation projects from pre-award review to award closeout, communicating and collaborating with all applicable parties (counties, cities, state, etc.).
  • Review mitigation project applications submitted, ensuring proper procedures are followed during the application review process, and answering questions as needed.
  • Submit completed recovery project applications to FEMA for funding.
  • Draft project agreements, reviewing requested modifications and updating as needed until a final agreement has been executed.
  • Continuously monitor active projects, reviewing quality reports, processing payments, communicating with all involved parties, and ensuring compliance regulations are met.
  • Collect, analyze, organize, and summarize financial/grant data.
  • Assist with federal and client-specific reporting requirements.
  • Track and monitor budgets; communicate results with project and client management.
  • Research and maintain fluency in rules and regulations associated with various federal programs, including but not limited to FEMA, the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA), State and Local Fiscal Recovery Funds (SLFRF), programs under the Infrastructure and Investment Jobs Act (IIJA), or other federal funding workstreams with state and local clients.
  • Form trusted advisor relationships with clients, project management, state agencies, sub-recipients, and internal subject matter experts.
  • Travel to various property sites to meet with owners, explain available funding opportunities and program details, encourage participation, and assist with the completion and submission of applications for assistance.
  • Assist client performance management of FEMA funds through routinely and proactively assessing the overall portfolio, anticipating challenges, and providing recommendations.
  • Upon completion of recovery projects, oversee final project inspections and closeout processes referencing the original project agreement.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental studies, Hazard Mitigation, Urban Planning, Public Administration, Water/Conservation Management, Environmental Science, Emergency Management, Economics, or a related field required.
  • 3 years' work experience required.
  • Located in FL or Southern GA preferred.
  • Sales or account management experience considered a plus.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and Microsoft Office 365 specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and Power Apps (BI, Query, Automate).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Up to 50% travel required depending on program assignment.

Who We Are:

YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. YA’s Government Services division partners with government and corporations to protect the communities we love. Our team specializes in emergency management, disaster mitigation, grants administration, floodplain management, urban and regional planning, and community resilience for public, private, and non-profit sector clients. Government Services brings the insight and creative strategies needed to deliver outstanding results to clientele around the nation.

What We Offer:

  • Employee-focused culture
  • Strong commitment to work-life balance
  • 100% Remote work
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid family care/sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • 401k w/match

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:

Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding your application will come from or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us directly at .

Adventist HealthCare seeks to hire an experienced Inpatient Coding Specialist for our Medical Coding Department who will embrace our mission to extend God’s care through the ministry of physical, mental, and spiritual healing.

As an Inpatient Coding Specialist, you will:
• Utilizes computerized encoder and other systems related to completing the coding process.
• Able to apply coding processes across all facilities in accordance with regulatory guidelines, appropriateness of care, and statistical data code capture.
• Prioritize and organize coding work activities to meet deadlines and organizational goals.
• Demonstrate the ability to maintain quality targets and production standards according to organization policies.
• Accurately abstracting inpatient accounts required for hospital reporting to federal, state, and organizational outlets.
• Maintain and increase personal knowledge and education to stay current with coding industry evolving trends.
• Adheres to official coding guidelines and standards of Ethical Coding, as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association for data collection, assigning ICD-10-CM diagnosis and PCS Procedure codes and other applicable coding classifications.
• Revenue Integrity, resolving coding and documentation issues that are related to reimbursement, compliance, and hospital revenue strategic planning.
• Ensure completeness and accuracy of available documentation within the medical record.
• Authors/create and identify physician query opportunities to clarify documentation and inconsistencies within the documentation.
• Monitors and reports of documentation discrepancies to the coding manager to assist with final coded data efforts.

Qualifications include:

• High school diploma or GED equivalent.

• Formal education in Health Information Management or a related field.
• One of the following credentials: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), and/or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA).
• Candidates holding a CPC credential must obtain the CCS certification within 6 months to 1 year of hire. Failure to meet this requirement may result in removal from the position.
• Acute hospital coding role/ inpatient coding experience preferred
•Minimum of three (3) years performing inpatient coding in an acute hospital setting
•Proficiency in computer skills relating to coding software, and Health Information Management systems such as Electronic Health Record (EHR).
•Demonstrate knowledge of coded data using code sets including ICD10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, IPPS coding and reimbursement regulation, APR-DRG grouping structure, MS-DRG grouping structure, and revenue cycle workflows with charges/charge master, and code edits.
•Knowledge of coding audits processes, denials management, and documentation improvement for coding specificity.
•Educated in medical terminology, disease process, anatomy and physiology, and surgical procedure coding.
• Candidates will be required to pass an inpatient coding assessment prior to hiring.
• Extended periods of time seated at a desk or in meetings.

Work Schedule:

  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Hours per Week: 40 hours
  • Typical Daily Schedule: Monday through Friday
  • Shift Type: Day Shift
  • Weekend Requirements: No Weekends
  • Competitive Performance Incentive:Eligible

$30.00 - $47.00

Under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), this position is classified as:

United States of America (Non-Exempt)

At Adventist HealthCare our job is to care for you.

We do this by offering:

  • Work life balance through nonrotating shifts

  • Recognition and rewards for professional expertise

  • Free Employee parking

  • Medical, Prescription, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their eligible dependents effective on your date of hire

  • Employer-paid Short & Long-Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance and AD&D, (short-term disability buy-up available)

  • Paid Time Off

  • Employer retirement contribution and match after 1-year of eligible employment with a 3-year vesting period

  • Voluntary benefits include flexible spending accounts, legal plans, and life, pet, auto, home, long term care, and critical illness & accident insurance

  • Subsidized childcare at participating childcare centers

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) support

As a faith-based organization, with over a century of caring for the communities in the Maryland area, Adventist HealthCare has earned a reputation for high-quality, compassionate care. Adventist HealthCare was the first and is the largest healthcare provider in Montgomery County.

If you want to make a difference in someone’s life every day, consider a position with a team of professionals who are doing just that, making a difference.

Join the Adventist HealthCare team today, apply now to be considered!

COVID-19 Vaccination

Adventist HealthCare strongly recommends all applicants to be fully vaccinated for COVID-19 before commencing employment. Applicants may be required to furnish proof of vaccination.

Tobacco and Drug Statement

Tobacco use is a well-recognized preventable cause of death in the United States and an important public health issue. In order to promote and maintain a healthy work environment, Adventist HealthCare will not hire applicants for employment who either state that they are nicotine users or who test positive for nicotine and drug use.

While some jurisdictions, including Maryland, permit the use of marijuana for medical purposes, marijuana continues to be classified as an illegal drug under the federal Controlled Substances Act. As a result, medical marijuana use will not be accepted as a valid explanation for a positive drug test result.

Adventist HealthCare will withdraw offers of employment to applicants who test positive for Cotinine (nicotine) and marijuana. Those testing positive are given the opportunity to re-apply in 90 days, if they can truthfully attest that they have not used any nicotine products in the past ninety (90) days and successfully pass follow-up testing. ("Nicotine products" include, but are not limited to: cigarettes, cigars, pipes, chewing tobacco, e-cigarettes, vaping products, hookah, and nicotine replacement products (e.g., nicotine gum, nicotine patches, nicotine lozenges, etc.).

Equal Employment Opportunity
Adventist HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to attracting, engaging, and developing the best people to cultivate our mission-centric culture. Our goal is to have a welcoming, equitable, and safe place to work and grow for all employees, no matter their background. AHC does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy and related medical conditions, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: Senior Physical Damage Adjuster
raw.excerpt: What we doHDVI is modern insurance for today’s fleets driven by service, safety and savings.
raw.description:
What we do

HDVI is modern insurance for today’s fleets driven by service, safety and savings. With real-time telematics data informing our risk models, we help lower premiums, mitigate risk, engage and reward drivers and simply put, offer uncomplicated protection for trucking fleets. Our customers are small to midsize truck fleet operators who benefit from dynamic and transparent pricing – automatically reducing their premiums for safer driving. Leveraging a best-in-class partner ecosystem, HDVI combines magnitude and stability with innovation to revolutionize commercial trucking insurance.

Why work here

HDVI is building the industry-defining commercial auto insurance company for the next 100 years. The $50 billion commercial auto industry hasn’t seen real innovation for decades and is broken in a number of ways, creating a significant opportunity for HDVI.

HDVI has a senior management team with experience building innovative insurance and logistics companies from zero to $1B+ enterprises and deep expertise in trucking insurance.

The HDVI Team is values-driven, data-driven, ambitious, and collaboratively minded, with a diverse background of experiences and skills in the insurance and logistics industries. We like challenges and building solutions that improve the quality of life for our customers. We offer generous benefits, including health, dental, vision, 401k match, flexible work environment, and unlimited PTO.

About the Role

As an HDVI Senior Physical Damage Adjuster, you will work closely with HDVI’s Claims and Fleet Services Teams. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of handling all aspects of Commercial Heavy Trucking claims inclusive of Third Party Auto Property Damage, First Party Auto Property Damage and Cargo claims. You will be responsible for influencing and providing claim resolution and tactical guidance to both internal and external customers in order to achieve world class claims outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Independently investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex and high-severity commercial auto physical damage and motor truck cargo claims from initial assignment through final resolution, including losses involving tractors, trailers, commercial vehicles, specialty equipment, cargo, freight, and other high-value commercial assets.
  • Conduct comprehensive coverage, causation, and damage investigations, evaluating policy provisions, endorsements, deductibles, loss circumstances, ownership, and extent of damages while utilizing telematics, dash-camera footage, photographs, GPS/ELD information, police reports, shipping records, and other available evidence to support sound claim decisions.
  • Investigate and evaluate complex motor truck cargo losses, including damaged, destroyed, contaminated, lost, stolen, or otherwise compromised freight by reviewing bills of lading, shipping documents, freight contracts, invoices, ownership records, cargo valuations, salvage opportunities, and other documentation necessary to determine coverage, causation, valuation, and exposure.
  • Critically evaluate commercial vehicle and equipment damages and related expenses, including repair estimates, supplements, appraisals, labor rates, parts selections, total-loss valuations, towing, storage, rental, loss-of-use/downtime, cargo handling, transloading, cleanup, and mitigation expenses to ensure accurate evaluations, appropriate cost control, and timely claim resolution.
  • Manage complex total-loss, cargo mitigation, and salvage activities, including vehicle valuation, title processing, lienholder requirements, salvage disposition, and the inspection, preservation, mitigation, storage, disposal, and salvage of damaged cargo while ensuring appropriate evidence and documentation are maintained.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate loss and expense reserves and negotiate complex settlements, recognizing adverse development, adjusting reserves as information evolves, and resolving claims within established authority with insureds, claimants, cargo owners, shippers, brokers, repair facilities, appraisers, vendors, and other involved parties.
  • Identify and maximize subrogation, salvage, contribution, indemnification, and other recovery opportunities, including claims involving Self-Insured Retentions (SIRs), large deductibles, Independent Owner-Operators (IOOs), leased equipment, and other complex trucking arrangements, while identifying fraud indicators, prior or unrelated damage, cargo theft, inflated valuations, questionable repair activity, or other matters requiring additional investigation or SIU referral.
  • Develop comprehensive claim action plans and coordinate specialized resources, including independent appraisers, cargo surveyors, salvage vendors, towing providers, repair facilities, experts, and other external resources, ensuring appropriate service, cost control, timely claim progression, and communication of significant developments to Claims leadership.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and mentor, participating in large-loss reviews, claim roundtables, reserve reviews, and complex claim discussions; providing technical guidance to less-experienced adjusters; and supporting Claims leadership with complex file reviews, training, quality assurance, vendor management, process improvement, and identification of emerging physical damage and cargo loss trends.
  • Effectively manage a complex claim inventory while maintaining comprehensive documentation and exceptional service, ensuring compliance with Claims Best Practices, regulatory requirements, service standards, and established authority levels while meeting expectations for quality, productivity, cycle time, cost containment, reserve accuracy, recoveries, customer service, and overall claim outcomes.

What You Have

  • 5+ years of auto physical damage claims experience, with significant commercial auto, trucking, heavy-equipment, and/or motor truck cargo experience preferred, including demonstrated ability to independently manage complex and high-severity tractor/trailer, specialty equipment, total-loss, and significant cargo exposures.
  • College education or an equivalent combination of education and relevant claims experience preferred, along with an active Adjuster’s License and the ability to obtain and maintain all required state licenses.
  • Advanced knowledge of commercial auto physical damage and motor truck cargo coverage, including policy provisions, endorsements, deductibles, commercial trucking operations, motor carrier exposures, Independent Owner-Operators (IOOs), leased equipment, large deductibles, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • Strong technical knowledge of commercial vehicle damage evaluation and repair, including heavy-truck repair practices, estimating, appraisals, supplements, labor rates, parts evaluation, repair-versus-replace decisions, total-loss valuation, title requirements, lienholder considerations, towing, storage, salvage processes, and cost-containment strategies.
  • Advanced motor truck cargo claim expertise, including investigating and evaluating cargo damage, theft, contamination, spoilage, loss, and other exposures; reviewing bills of lading, invoices, shipping documents, freight contracts, and valuation documentation; and coordinating mitigation, inspection, transloading, storage, salvage, disposal, and recovery activities.
  • Strong reserving, recovery, and investigative capabilities, including establishing appropriate reserves, recognizing adverse development, adjusting reserves as exposures evolve, and identifying and pursuing subrogation, salvage, contribution, indemnification, and other recovery opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and investigate complex or questionable claim activity, including fraud indicators, unrelated or prior damage, questionable repair activity, cargo theft concerns, inflated valuations, and other matters requiring additional investigation, while effectively utilizing telematics, dash-camera footage, GPS/ELD data, photographs, police reports, and other evidence to evaluate coverage, causation, liability, and damages.
  • Experience coordinating and managing external claims resources, including appraisers, cargo surveyors, repair facilities, towing providers, salvage vendors, experts, and other service providers to support timely, accurate, cost-effective claim outcomes.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, negotiation, communication, organizational, and independent decision-making skills, with the ability to manage a complex claim inventory, competing priorities, and critical deadlines while maintaining a strong internal and external customer focus and serving as a technical resource and mentor to less-experienced claims professionals.
  • Strong technology capabilities, including proficiency with Google Workspace, Adobe Acrobat, estimating applications, and claims management technology; experience with Snapsheet, CCC, Mitchell, or similar platforms preferred, with the ability to effectively leverage technology and data to support efficient investigation, evaluation, and claim resolution.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & an enticing bonus program - we want our success to be yours too
  • Unlimited PTO with 11 paid holidays each year
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Short/Long Term Disability, Basic Life, and AD&D to support you and your well-being
  • FSA / HSA programs
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match contribution
  • Inclusive Parental Leave policy that supports all parents
  • Wednesdays are standing meeting-free, allowing you to focus on deep work without distractions
  • Birthday meal reimbursement, because celebrating our employees is part of our company culture
  • A remote-friendly environment with the opportunity to participate in periodic in-person team offsites
  • All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer. HDVI will not sponsor candidates for employment visa status, such as an H1-B visa. HDVI does not interview or hire students or recent graduates with J-1 or F-1 visa or similar temporary work authorization
  • If California Resident, please review HDVI’s enhanced Privacy Policy

Employment Practices

    All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer. HDVI does not sponsor employment visas (such as H-1B) for new hires.
If you are interested in this position, please contact our Senior People Operations Specialist, Morgan Harrison. You can reach him at .

Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

CTI Audit Solutions is seeking a specific stop loss claim auditor intern to joining our growing team!

For over 30 years it has been CTI’s mission to help self-funded health plan sponsors reduce claim expense and improve service to their employees through independent audit and control of their third-party claim administration. Our philosophy of continuous quality improvement (CQI) techniques in conjunction with our statistical process control methodology allows us to ensure a high degree of consistency in our approach to medical claim auditing. Efficient planning and maximized use of our proprietary systems and technology produces a streamlined audit product requiring fewer hours than competitors to complete.

This internship offers an excellent opportunity for students or early-career professionals interested in healthcare claims, insurance, data analysis, and auditing. The position is remote and approximately 20 hours per week, with flexible scheduling.

Position Summary:

The Specific Stop Loss Claim Auditor Intern will support the Audit Team by reviewing medical claim documentation, analyzing data, and assisting with stop loss claim audits. The intern will gain hands-on experience with healthcare claims administration, reimbursement methodologies, and audit processes while working alongside experienced professionals in the industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with reviewing and auditing specific stop loss claim submissions.

  • Validate claim documentation and supporting records for completeness and accuracy.

  • Analyze medical and pharmaceutical claims data.

  • Assist in identifying claim discrepancies, overpayments, and audit findings.

  • Utilize Excel and other Microsoft Office applications to organize, analyze, and report data.

  • Support auditors in preparing client reports and audit summaries.

  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and special projects.

  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and sensitive client data.

  • Communicate effectively with team members regarding audit findings and project status.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Currently a sophomore in college pursuing a degree in Healthcare or a Science related field.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a remote environment.

The Category Manager is responsible for developing and executing strategic sourcing and category management strategies that optimize cost, quality, service, innovation, and supply continuity across assigned spend categories. Job Description:

Omega CRM is a Merkle & Dentsu company, leader in development of Customer Experience services, with +20 years of experience in the use of Technology applied to Marketing and providing a unique Customer Relationship with mainly focus on Innovation is looking for a Junior Salesforce Developer.


Are you passionate about software engineering and ready to launch your career in the world’s leading cloud ecosystem?

We are expanding our technical team and looking for high-potential talent to join the #1 Salesforce Partner in Spain. If you are looking for an environment where you can learn directly from top-tier Technical Architects, build solutions for enterprise-scale projects, and fast-track your professional growth, this is the place for you.


What We Are Looking For


We value strong computer science fundamentals, analytical thinking, and a drive to solve complex business challenges with modern software engineering practices.

  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent university degree.
  • Languages:Advanced English (C1 preferred / solid B2+ minimum), capable of conducting technical discussions and collaborating smoothly in cross-border meetings.

What You’ll Do


Working within an agile, cross-functional engineering team, you will take part in end-to-end Salesforce implementations with hands-on mentorship from senior developers and solution architects. Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, configuring, and developing scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Aura.
  • Writing clean, maintainable code, implementing robust unit tests, and participating in CI/CD release cycles.
  • Integrating Salesforce with external enterprise platforms via REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Collaborating in international, Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Pursuing a structured continuous learning plan aimed at achieving key official certifications (Platform Developer I & II, JavaScript Developer I, and more).

You fit into one of these two profiles:


  • Junior Salesforce Developer: Up to 1 year of hands-on experience building on the Salesforce platform (Apex, Triggers, SOQL, LWC/Aura).
  • Re-skilling Software Engineer: Solid foundation in modern object-oriented programming (Java, C#, Python) or modern full-stack web development (JavaScript/TypeScript), combined with recent specialized Salesforce training (such as a Master's degree, intensive bootcamp, or official certifications like Administrator or Platform Developer I).

Nice to Have:

  • Curiosity & passion for Enterprise AI: High interest in Agentic AI, Generative AI applications, Prompt Engineering, or tools within the Salesforce AI ecosystem (Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Einstein Studio).
  • Familiarity with Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD tools.
  • Understanding of design patterns, clean code principles, and relational databases.
  • Genuine curiosity for cloud architecture and proactive problem-solving.

What We Offer

  • Work with the Trailblazers of AI: As the #1 Salesforce Partner in Spain and the first to roll out Agentforce solutions, you will have the unique opportunity to work on the market's most forward-thinking, vanguard AI & Cloud initiatives from day one.
  • Accelerated Career Path: mentorship, regular performance reviews, and a clear, fast-track trajectory toward Senior Developer and Technical Architect paths.
  • 100% Sponsored Certifications: Full coverage of official exam vouchers & premier training resources.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Hybrid/remote work flexibility and adaptable working hours.
  • Global, Collaborative Culture: An open, transparent engineering culture that values initiative, knowledge sharing, and teamwork.

About us


Omega CRM, a Merkle Company, is a global digital company specialising in accelerating the Business Experience (BX) of our clients through customer-centric solutions, technology, and data – all enhanced by AI.

Together with Merkle, we form the largest Customer Experience Management (CXM) agency in Spain, and as part of the dentsu group, we offer end-to-end solutions that integrate media, creativity, content, technology, and strategy to deliver real business impact.

With over 23 years of experience, a team of 580+ professionals from 24 nationalities, and 2,500+ certifications, Omega CRM is a recognised leader in the Salesforce ecosystem in Spain.

We operate across key industries including Retail, Healthcare, Pharma, Real Estate, Education, and Non-Profit, delivering omnichannel experiences in Customer Service, eCommerce, Marketing, and Analytics.

Client satisfaction is at our core (rating: 4.9/5), and we’ve been recognised with awards such as Salesforce Partner of the Year FY23 and Most Innovative Project (Iberia).

At Omega CRM, we believe in growth through people – guided by our values: #Talent, #Flexibility, #Commitment, and #Innovation. We grow #Together.

raw.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

Versaterm is hiring a Sales Account Manager to grow our footprint inside existing public safety customers. This is an expansion role, not a new-logo role. You'll work a portfolio of established strategic accounts and sell the full Versaterm ecosystem into them: CAD, RMS, DroneSense, Community Report, and the rest of the portfolio as it grows. Success means deepening relationships, uncovering new needs, and turning satisfied customers into multi-product, long-term partners.

This job posting is being used to fill an existing vacancy.

What You Do

  • Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of existing strategic accounts, including state police, large municipal police departments, county and regional dispatch centers, and multi-agency programs.
  • Develop account plans that map each customer's current Versaterm footprint against the full product ecosystem and identify the highest-value expansion opportunities.
  • Drive upsells and cross-sell of additional products, modules, agencies, and subscription tiers into the installed base.
  • Lead renewal and expansion conversations, structuring pricing and bundles that increase customer value and Versaterm's recurring revenue.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with chiefs, sheriffs, CIOs, dispatch directors, and elected or appointed decision-makers.
  • Navigate public-sector procurement for add-on purchases, including funding sources, council or board approvals, co-op purchasing vehicles, and contract amendments.
  • Partner closely with implementation, customer success, support, product, marketing, and contracts to keep customers happy and surface new opportunities early.
  • Work with the SAE team so that new customers are handed off cleanly and nurtured after go-live.
  • Forecast accurately and maintain disciplined pipeline and CRM hygiene.
  • Represent Versaterm at customer sites, user groups, and industry conferences, with regular travel.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of enterprise software sales or account management experience, ideally in public safety, government, or another complex, long-cycle market
  • Proven track record of growing revenue within existing accounts through upsell, cross-sell, and renewals, and consistently meeting or exceeding quota
  • Ability to speak credibly about a multi-product portfolio and connect it to a customer's operational and budget realities
  • Working knowledge of public sector buying processes, including funding, approvals, and procurement vehicles
  • Credibility with law enforcement, dispatch, or public safety leaders; existing relationships in the space are a strong plus
  • Experience with CAD, RMS, or related public safety technology is highly preferred
  • Strong executive presence, negotiation skills, and written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable with 50% travel.

Note: Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

Versaterm is committed to fair and equitable compensation that is competitive, consistent, and aligned with the value each role contributes to our organization. The starting salary for this position will be dependent upon many factors, such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience, education, training as well as internal equity, market data, and business needs. In addition to base salary and our comprehensive benefits offering, some roles may also be eligible for variable compensation such as incentive plans or discretionary performance bonuses.

AI is central to how Versaterm builds and delivers solutions for our customers. Within Talent Acquisition, we use AI-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, helping our team work more efficiently and spend more time connecting with great talent. AI supports our work, but all hiring and employment decisions are made by people.

Versaterm is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and a barrier-free workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the recruitment process and apply to the terms and conditions of employment. For more information, please contact .

Serving as an experienced advisor, their team provides targeted instruction in financial literacy, critical life skills, and regulatory compliance, cultivating lasting relationships between organizations and the populations they support.

Solid experience building and maintaining ELT pipelines using dbt.

Experience orchestrating data workflows using Apache Airflow or a similar orchestration platform.

Comfort creating reports and data visualizations in modern tools like Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI.

Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics engineering best practices.


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience designing and preparing scalable, high-quality data foundations for AI/ML applications using Snowflake Cortex AI

raw.description:
Job Title: SVP - Sales - QualityOne

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva QualityOne is seeking an accomplished global sales leader to accelerate growth across our enterprise software business serving Consumer Products, Food & Beverage, Chemicals, and emerging industries. In this role, your teams will be responsible for both developing new markets through proactive prospecting and expanding established business through strategic account development.
As a key member of the QualityOne leadership team, you will play a critical role in translating our growth strategy into commercial execution, contributing market insights, aligning sales priorities, and driving global results.
The ideal candidate is a builder who combines exceptional people leadership, enterprise sales expertise, and a fierce commitment to sales excellence. You will develop a high-performing global organization, leading regional and industry sales directors across North America and Europe. Success in this position requires a hands-on leader who knows that great sales performance stems from strong talent, proven methodologies, rigorous process, and consistent execution—not just individual relationships.

What You'll Do

Sales Leadership & Culture

    • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing sales organization across North America and Europe
    • Establish a consistent global sales culture emphasizing accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement
    • Recruit and develop exceptional talent, address performance gaps, and build organizational capabilities to support growth

Revenue Growth & Market Development

    • Own global sales performance, including new customer acquisition, renewal expansion, pipeline development, and revenue targets
    • Drive growth in established industries while building market presence and generating new business in emerging industries
    • Develop effective prospecting, territory, and account strategies to penetrate markets where customer relationships and brand awareness are still developing
    • Personally engage in strategic enterprise opportunities, executive relationships, and complex competitive sales cycles

Sales Excellence & Operational Discipline

    • Establish and reinforce consistent sales methodologies, qualification standards, and opportunity management practices
    • Drive disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, and performance accountability
    • Build a metrics-driven sales operating cadence that improves productivity, predictability, and win rates
    • Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans and ensure consistent execution

Business, Strategic & Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Serve as a key member of the QualityOne leadership team, helping translate business growth strategies into actionable sales priorities and measurable outcomes
    • Build trusted relationships with senior customer executives and support value-based enterprise selling
    • Partner closely with industry Strategy, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Services, Product, and Finance to align execution and accelerate growth
    • Translate market insights and customer feedback into actionable sales and business priorities
    • Align global teams around common objectives while adapting execution to regional market needs

Requirements

    • Enterprise Technology Sales Leadership: 15+ years of enterprise software or technology sales experience, including 8+ years leading sales teams and consistently delivering revenue growth
    • Builder & Market Development Experience: Demonstrated success building sales organizations, entering new industries or markets, developing prospecting capabilities, and establishing market presence while growing established businesses
    • Sales Methodology & Operational Excellence: Strong belief in structured, repeatable sales processes with proven experience implementing sales methodologies, forecasting discipline, pipeline management, and measurable performance improvements
    • People Leadership & Culture Building: Exceptional ability to recruit, coach, develop, and drive accountability of sales professionals, while building a collaborative, high-performance culture across multiple geographies
    • Enterprise Selling & Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage C-level executives, win competitive opportunities, and collaborate effectively across functions. Manufacturing industry experience preferred
    • Drive & Independence: Driven self-starter capable of operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
    • Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel up to 35% for customer meetings, events, and internal alignment
    • Consultative Sales Approach: Selling technical or business solutions into complex organizations, which require explicit analysis of pain, current state, future state vision, and strong value proposition to win

Nice to Have

    • Experience selling enterprise applications into Consumer Products, Food & Beverage, Chemicals or other manufacturing industries
    • Quality Management, Document Management, Laboratory Information Management or Product Life Cycle Management software experience
    • Experience successfully launching sales efforts in new industries, geographies, product categories, especially where brand recognition and established relationships are limited
    • Demonstrated success in maturing and scaling sales organizations through period of growth or change
    • Experience managing sales managers across North America and Europe, including navigating different market dynamics, cultures and sales practices

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $200,000 - $300,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

raw.description:
We’re a B2B SaaS company in pricing and market intelligence, serving brands, manufacturers, and retailers. We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to win new business with large brands and retailers as we move upmarket.

This role is for someone who has closed big, complex deals and wants to do it again. You’ll own a $1.5M+ new business number and a named list of enterprise accounts. You’ll build your own pipeline, get in front of pricing, eCommerce, merchandising, and executive buyers, and close six-figure contracts through procurement, legal, and security review. You’ll tie Wiser’s data to outcomes that buyers care about: margin, price position, MAP compliance, and promotional performance. You may also take on select existing enterprise accounts where there’s clear room to grow, finding the white space and expanding the relationship. If you are comfortable with a 90 to 120-day sales cycle, getting the whole buying committee behind a deal, and walking away with a signed contract, this is built for you.

You’ll report to the VP of Sales and Marketing and work closely with Sales Engineers, Customer Success, and the wider sales team to win new accounts and set them up to grow.

Fluency in both spoken and written French is required for this position.

Essential Functions

  • Own the full sales cycle for new business with enterprise brands, manufacturers, and retailers, from first outreach to signed contract.

  • Build and work a named list of target accounts, with a territory plan that puts the highest-value opportunities first.

  • Map each target account’s buying committee across pricing, eCommerce, merchandising, sales, and executive leadership, and build relationships well beyond your first point of contact.

  • Lead discovery that uncovers core business problems and ties Wiser’s data to outcomes buyers care about: margin, price position, MAP compliance, and promotional performance.

  • Build proposals and business cases that hold up to finance, procurement, and executive review.

  • Negotiate commercial terms and work deals through legal, security, and procurement.

  • Run tailored product demos over Microsoft Teams and in person.

  • Where assigned, grow select existing enterprise accounts: find the white space in product adoption, regions, and categories, and work with Customer Success through renewals to expand the relationship.

  • Use our sales stack (Apollo, HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Claude) to research accounts, build pipeline, and keep an accurate forecast.

  • Share what you hear in the market to sharpen our ICP, messaging, collateral, and prospecting approach.

  • Maintain regular and reliable work attendance.

  • Experience: 5+ years in quota-carrying sales roles, with at least 3 in enterprise closing roles.

  • Industry background: 3+ years selling SaaS or data products, with a track record selling into consumer brands, manufacturers, and/or retailers. Pricing, market intelligence, or eCommerce analytics experience is a strong plus.

  • Quota: Has consistently carried and hit $1.5M+ annual quota in new business, closing six-figure deals with multi-stakeholder buying committees.

  • Proven results: Documented attainment (100%+ in at least two of the last three years). President’s Club, top-rep rankings, or similar recognition strongly preferred.

  • Methodology: Hands-on use of a structured enterprise sales methodology such as MEDDICC, Challenger, or SPIN.

  • Executive presence: Comfortable presenting to and negotiating with VP and C-level buyers.

  • Self-sourced pipeline: Proven record of building your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, with a meaningful share of closed deals sourced yourself rather than handed to you by marketing or SDRs.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Viapol, a marca especialista na construção de sonhos, vai além de fornecer soluções químicas para a construção civil; somos parceiros na realização de projetos e novas conquistas. Desde 1990, temos nos dedicado a compreender as necessidades dos nossos clientes e a oferecer alternativas modernas que resistem ao tempo, garantindo a tranquilidade em cada empreendimento.

Com sede em Caçapava-SP, possuímos o maior parque fabril do setor em toda a América Latina, demonstrando nossa capacidade de inovação e produção. Além disso, contamos com uma filial em Candeias-BA, atendendo às regiões Norte e Nordeste do país, e um escritório técnico comercial em São Paulo (SP), sempre próximos dos nossos clientes.

Estamos em busca de um(a)Especialista IT SAP EWM/WM e MMpara atuar como referência técnica no suporte, sustentação e evolução das soluções SAP voltadas para Gestão de Materiais e Armazéns. O profissional será responsável por atender as operações da América Latina, atuando junto às áreas de negócio para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, conduzir projetos e garantir a eficiência dos processos corporativos.

  • Atuar como especialista funcional nos módulos SAP MM, WM e EWM.
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos com as áreas de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções funcionais e técnicas.
  • Conduzir parametrizações, melhorias e suporte avançado dos processos SAP.
  • Parametrizações de Impostos > TAXBRA, J1BTAX bem como no próprio módulo.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar processos relacionados a suprimentos, estoques, armazenagem e fiscal.
  • Atuar em projetos de implementação, melhorias contínuas e automação de processos.
  • Elaborar e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave e usuários finais.
  • Realizar testes, homologações e garantir a qualidade das soluções implementadas.
  • Interface com equipes globais de TI, fornecedores e parceiros SAP.
  • Liderar iniciativas e projetos ligados à Gestão de Materiais e Gestão de Armazéns.
  • Apoiar a gestão e administração de projetos de pequeno e médio porte.


    • Mandatório Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
    • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
    • Experiência em ambientes multinacionais.
    • Vivência com projetos de transformação digital e automação de processos.
    Experiência sólida em:
    SAP MM (Purchasing, MIGO, MIRO, Contratos, Cotações e Estratégias de Liberação).
    • SAP WM e SAP EWM.
    • Gestão de Materiais, Estoques e Armazéns.
    • Implementações SAP.
    • Configuração de RF Barcoding em ambientes SAP EWM/WM.
    Conhecimentos em:
    • SAP S/4HANA.
    • Fiscal e tributação brasileira.
    • Ferramentas de relatórios e consultas SAP.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.

In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.

What you'll do

  • Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.
  • Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.
  • Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.
  • Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
  • Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
  • Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
  • Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
  • Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.
  • A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.
  • The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.
  • Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.
  • Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.
  • Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.
  • Nice to have: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.

About the team

The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You'll help shape our playbooks, templates, and standards as we scale.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Job Title: Director - Clinical Operations Strategy - SMB West

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our full Clinical Operations suite across the small and mid-size market in the Western United States.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Clinical Operations applications – including CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, Study Training, Payments, Site Connect, and OpenData Clinical – across the SMB West territory. The ideal candidate is a versatile generalist who can speak credibly to every product in the suite, and possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial operations within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how small and mid-size sponsors and CROs run their clinical trials.

What You'll Do

    • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of the Veeva Clinical Operations suite among small and mid-size Life Sciences companies across the Western United States, aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
    • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a unified clinical operations platform in improving trial oversight, site activation speed, monitoring efficiency, and operational compliance, tailored to the resourcing realities of smaller organizations
    • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s SMB West sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native clinical operations platform, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure territory revenue goals are achieved
    • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical operations technology at key industry events, regional conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility across the SMB West market
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Clinical Operations roadmap based on SMB market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
    • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on the trial management pain points specific to small and mid-size sponsors, identify emerging trends in decentralized trials and outsourcing models, and provide actionable insights to enhance our Clinical Operations products and overall business strategy

Requirements

    • 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
    • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management across a broad product portfolio
    • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations leaders, and C-level executives)
    • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

    • Clinical Operations Breadth: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy or implementation across multiple clinical operations applications, such as CTMS, eTMF, study startup, study training, payments, or site collaboration; the ability to speak credibly to any product in the suite is a core competency
    • SMB Market Experience: Specific experience working with small and mid-size sponsors and CROs, where teams are lean, budgets are tight, and buying cycles move quickly

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to measure, understand, and help optimize Coalition’s insurance business. You’ll use analytics, experimentation, and modern statistical techniques to improve the cyber insurance customer experience and grow revenue safely and efficiently.

You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and insurance stakeholders to identify emerging trends, prioritize opportunities, and turn complex data into clear, actionable strategies that shape product and operational roadmaps.

Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional analytics projects that uncover insights and optimization opportunities across the end-to-end customer journey
  • Support the team’s long term goal of enabling data analytics agents for the business through context engineering support and data analysis
  • Design and analyze experiments, and establish best practices for test design, power, guardrails, and interpretation
  • Define, document, and maintain core funnel metrics, and build automated dashboards and reporting for leadership
  • Synthesize findings from disparate data sources into clear narratives with recommended actions
  • Develop data models and scalable analytical workflows that improve reliability, repeatability, and time-to-insight
  • Influence product and revenue leadership with data-backed recommendations and OKR tracking
  • Mentor junior analysts and scientists, and contribute to team standards for code quality and documentation

Skills and Qualifications

  • 6+ years in analytics or data science, with demonstrated product or revenue impact
  • Expert SQL skills, including complex modeling, performance optimization, and clear documentation
  • Proficiency in Python or R for analysis, experimentation, and reproducible workflows
  • Strong grasp of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, experiment design, causal thinking, and interpretation
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau, and the ability to build reliable, executive-ready dashboards
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot
  • Domain experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, or other regulated industries
  • Familiarity with tools like Amplitude, Google Analytics, Marketo, Salesforce, Segment, or Zuora
  • Experience with analytics workflow tools such as dbt or Airflow
  • Exposure to causal inference methods and quasi-experimental designs

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $172,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $205,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.
