About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Product Quality Oversight team builds and operates the first line of defense quality oversight program for unsecured lending, including personal loans, small-dollar loans, and cash line. The team assesses whether lending decisions, disclosures, customer-facing workflows, and servicing outputs operate as intended and meet regulatory and internal policy requirements.

As the Product Quality Manager, Unsecured Lending at Upstart, you will lead end-to-end quality testing for assigned regulatory areas and help shape a scalable, data-driven oversight program. You’ll define risk-based testing coverage, partner with Engineering to design and validate automated monitoring, and work across teams to resolve control gaps. This is an individual contributor role.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead testing for assigned regulatory areas from planning through reporting, defining risk-based coverage, sampling approaches, test scripts, and documented conclusions.
  • Set testing priorities and timelines for assigned areas, and coordinate testers' work to meet them.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into testable attributes and criteria; update test scripts and coverage as regulations or products change; and decide when to re-scope testing or seek Compliance or Legal interpretation as facts change.
  • Lead control design walkthroughs to understand the end-to-end process, including dependencies across systems, teams, and third parties; challenge whether controls are designed to address the risk, and set the testing approach.
  • Evaluate whether lending controls operate as intended across origination, servicing, and collections; identify systemic gaps and escalate findings supported by evidence.
  • Partner with Engineering on automated and AI-assisted monitoring requirements, verifying rule logic, testing populations, outputs, and missed exceptions before relying on results.
  • Lead validation after product or process changes, review and reperform testers’ work, and help maintain consistent methods and audit-ready documentation.
  • Translate findings and root causes into actionable recommendations; work with Product, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk to advance remediation and support reviews by second-line testing and Internal Audit.
  • Help improve the oversight program and guide other testers while using approved AI tools responsibly, verifying AI-assisted conclusions against source requirements and manual checks.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in compliance testing, quality control or assurance, internal audit, or regulatory examination in consumer lending.
  • Experience independently designing and leading end-to-end quality or compliance testing for consumer lending products, systems, or transactions.
  • Experience developing and applying risk-based sampling methods, standardized testing criteria, and documented conclusions under consumer financial regulations such as TILA/Reg Z, ECOA/Reg B, FCRA, EFTA/Reg E, FDCPA/Reg F, or UDAAP.
  • Experience analyzing testing populations, control results, or automated monitoring outputs to assess completeness and identify exceptions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of automated lending platforms, digital lending products, or credit decisioning systems.
  • Experience with quality oversight for unsecured installment loans or lines of credit.
  • Experience designing or validating automated or AI-assisted quality monitoring, including checks for missed exceptions.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional remediation and communicate control assessments to stakeholders with different areas of expertise.
  • Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) or a similar compliance certification.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

[OPTIONAL] In-Office requirements. You will be required to work from the {insert location} office x days per week/month.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$145,100—$201,100 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

raw.description:
Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‑standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‑education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‑on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence—values that continue to define us as we scale.

At SIG, we help colleges and universities work smarter by aligning technology, processes, and people to support student and institutional success. We're looking for an experienced Ellucian Colleague Finance Consultant who understands both the system and the business of higher education finance.

In this role, you'll partner directly with college and university clients to help them maximize the value of their Colleague investment. Whether supporting an implementation, improving financial processes, guiding system optimization, or helping clients navigate change, you'll serve as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into practical solutions.

You'll work closely with finance leaders, business officers, controllers, and end users to solve challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and create more efficient and effective financial operations. Your expertise in Colleague Finance and higher education business processes will help institutions streamline workflows, improve reporting, strengthen data integrity, and achieve their strategic goals.

If you've spent years working in a college or university finance office, or have consulting experience supporting the Ellucian Colleague Finance module, this is an opportunity to make a broader impact by helping institutions across the country transform the way they work.

SIG employees work remotely within the United States.

What You'll Do

As an Ellucian Colleague Finance Consultant, you will:

  • Partner with colleges and universities to implement, optimize, and support the Ellucian Colleague Finance module.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to finance leaders and staff, helping them align system capabilities with institutional goals and business needs.
  • Analyze and improve business processes across general ledger, budgeting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, purchasing, and financial reporting functions.
  • Recommend best practices and creative solutions that increase efficiency, improve data quality, and reduce manual effort.
  • Lead client training sessions, workshops, and discovery discussions to ensure successful adoption of processes and technology.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to understand operational challenges and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
  • Support software implementations, upgrades, testing activities, and system enhancements.
  • Troubleshoot functional and system issues, identify root causes, and guide clients toward resolution.
  • Develop user documentation, process guides, and training materials that empower client teams.
  • Stay current on higher education finance trends, Ellucian product enhancements, and industry best practices, bringing new ideas and recommendations to clients.
  • Partner with SIG project teams to deliver high-quality client outcomes while maintaining project timelines and commitments.
  • Help institutions leverage Colleague more strategically by identifying opportunities for automation, improved reporting, and process modernization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients view you as a trusted partner and subject matter expert.
  • Finance teams become more efficient through improved processes and effective use of Colleague.
  • Projects are delivered on time and with high client satisfaction.
  • Institutions gain greater visibility into their financial information through better reporting and data integrity.
  • End users feel confident, supported, and equipped to use the system effectively.

What You'll Bring

The most successful consultants in this role combine deep higher education finance expertise with a passion for helping institutions improve the way they work.

  • Five or more years of experience working within higher education, with a strong understanding of the unique operational and financial challenges colleges and universities face.
  • Five or more years of hands-on experience with Ellucian Colleague, including advanced knowledge of the Finance module and its application across institutional finance operations.
  • Experience supporting or leading Colleague Finance implementations, upgrades, or optimization initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of higher education financial operations, including general ledger, budgeting, purchasing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.
  • Experience developing and leveraging reporting solutions to support financial decision-making, budget management, reconciliation activities, and operational analysis.
  • An understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS applications, cloud-based solutions, and digital transformation initiatives within higher education.
  • The ability to analyze complex business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver practical solutions that create meaningful efficiencies.
  • Experience in a consulting, advisory, or client-facing role where building relationships and guiding stakeholders through change was a key part of your success.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose functional issues, collaborate with technical teams, and communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, paired with a customer-first mindset and a commitment to delivering an outstanding client experience.
  • The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and approach challenges with curiosity, initiative, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel periodically to support client engagements and project needs.

Nice to Have

While not required, the following qualifications will help you stand out:

  • Experience leading or managing project-based work across multiple stakeholders and timelines.
  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience helping institutions modernize finance operations through process improvement, automation, or technology transformation initiatives.
  • Previous experience working as a consultant serving higher education clients.

What Makes Someone Thrive at SIG

Our best consultants are collaborative, adaptable, and genuinely enjoy solving problems alongside our clients. They bring both expertise and curiosity to every engagement, balancing industry best practices with an understanding that every institution has unique goals, cultures, and challenges. They are trusted advisors who can translate complex systems and processes into practical recommendations that help clients move forward with confidence.

Pay and Benefits

  • The salary range is $100,000 -$115,000 plus bonus
  • Health, Vision, Dental & Life Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • 3 Weeks Vacation, Sick Leave & Paid Holidays
  • 401(K) with a 5% Employer Contribution
  • Pet Insurance

The listed salary range for this position is indicative and subject to adjustment based on the candidate's unique skills and location. Final compensation will be determined through mutual agreement between the successful candidate and SIG.

SIG is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl is expanding its Tax team to meet Cribl’s rapidly growing needs! In this role, you’ll be part of a high-performing, small but mighty Tax team that partners with the accounting team and provides excellent cross-functional support to the rest of the business (e.g. Legal, Finance, People Team, Engineering and Business Systems). Having a great sense of humor and customer service mindset is imperative. At Cribl, we are irreverent but serious.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Manage federal, state, local and international income tax compliance, including extensions, estimated payments, information returns and foreign statutory or tax-return requirements.
  • Manage the quarterly and annual global income tax provision under ASC 740, including current and deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, tax-rate reconciliations, journal entries and disclosures.
  • Manage recurring and special projects involving R&D tax credits, IRC Section 382 limitations, state apportionment, tax attributes and other material corporate tax matters.
  • Support sales and use tax filings using tax software (e.g., Avalara), taxability studies, new product initiatives, and tax code mappings
  • File annual business license returns, property taxes, and gross receipt tax returns
  • Lead tax month end close processes, including accurately preparing and reviewing tax journal entries, tax general ledger account reconciliations, and meeting tax close deadlines
  • Manage tax IPO readiness initiatives and internal controls for a rapidly growing company preparing for public-company reporting and SOX expectations.
  • Build AI scalable tax processes, AI-driven tax workflows, AI automations, or AI system integrations for tax reporting and tax compliance
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours (if on call is not required)


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration or a related field; active CPA license or JD/LLM in taxation strongly preferred.
  • Eight or more years of relevant corporate tax experience, including public accounting and/or an in-house tax role in a high-growth business.
  • Strong technical knowledge of ASC 740, US GAAP tax accounting and financial-statement tax disclosures, with experience leading quarterly or annual provision work.
  • Solid US federal corporate tax foundation and experience overseeing multi-state and international income tax compliance.
  • Knowledge of international tax concepts, transfer pricing and intercompany transactions, with the ability to implement adviser recommendations in accounting and operating processes.
  • Experience using a tax software package to prepare income tax returns and tax provisions
  • Knowledge of international indirect taxes and US sales and use tax.
  • Adept at using tax research software tools and monitoring global tax law developments
  • A self-driven, positive attitude, thirst for learning, ability to adapt to rapidly changing priorities and solve problems.
  • Experience designing and shipping AI-driven workflows, automations, or system integrations for the tax function
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

$110,900—$162,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. Cerchiamo una persona che sappia trovare i migliori talenti commerciali, anche dove gli altri non guardano.

Sales Valley è una startup HR che aiuta le aziende a costruire team commerciali ad alte performance, occupandosi di selezione e sviluppo di profili Sales e Business. Siamo in forte crescita e vogliamo ampliare il nostro team HR, oggi di 5 persone, con una persona motivata e orientata ai risultati, che voglia crescere insieme a noi.

Se hai già esperienza nella selezione di figure commerciali, sia dipendenti (Sales, Business Developer, Account) sia agenti di commercio in Partita IVA sul territorio, e ti trovi a tuo agio con volumi elevati e ritmi sostenuti, questa è l’opportunità giusta.

Il ruolo

Entri nel team HR e lavori sulle nostre ricerche commerciali, con il supporto del team su metodo, priorità e standard di qualità.

  • Sourcing e head hunting: ricerca attiva su LinkedIn, banche dati, job board e canali alternativi per individuare Sales, Business Developer, Account Manager, Area Manager, consulenti commerciali e agenti di commercio

  • Screening e selezione: primo contatto, screening telefonici, colloqui conoscitivi e valutazione di motivazione e attitudine commerciale

  • Shortlist e reportistica: preparazione di shortlist e report candidati e gestione del feedback loop con candidati e clienti

  • Gestione della pipeline: conduzione di più ricerche in parallelo, mantenendo attivo un bacino di candidati qualificati

  • Relazione con il cliente: con il tempo, partecipazione agli intake e alla gestione diretta delle aziende clienti

Il profilo che cerchiamo

  • 1-3 anni di esperienza in recruiting o ricerca e selezione, in agenzia, in azienda o in una rete vendita

  • Esperienza comprovata nella selezione di figure commerciali (requisito prioritario), in particolare: profili commerciali dipendenti: Sales, Business Developer, Account Manager, Key Account, Area Manager e ruoli affini, agenti di commercio in Partita IVA e reti vendita sul territorio

  • Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza maturata nel settore energetico o immobiliare, o in settori affini come telco, assicurativo, utilities e vendita diretta

  • Conoscenza del mondo commerciale: sai leggere un profilo Sales, valutarne risultati e attitudine e distinguere le logiche di un contratto da dipendente da quelle di un mandato di agenzia con sistema provvigionale

  • Spiccata attitudine al sourcing proattivo e alla gestione dei volumi

  • Ottime capacità comunicative e di persuasione, al telefono e in colloquio

  • Orientamento al risultato, spirito di iniziativa e voglia di crescere sul campo

  • Organizzazione e autonomia nella gestione di più progetti in parallelo

Costituiscono un plus

  • Conoscenza di base di CCNL, tipologie contrattuali e contratto di agenzia (Enasarco, mono/plurimandato)

  • Residenza o domicilio a Torino o zone limitrofe

Modalità di lavoro

Full remote, con la possibilità di lavorare dal nostro ufficio di Torino, zona San Salvario, a 10 minuti da Porta Nuova, indicativamente 1 giorno a settimana per chi vive in zona. Per chi vive fuori Torino prevediamo momenti di incontro periodici.

Cosa offriamo

  • L’ingresso in una startup giovane, dinamica e in forte crescita, dove il tuo contributo è visibile e riconosciuto

  • Collaborazione in Partita IVA con perimetro definito e forfait stabilito per ogni ricerca

  • Continuità nel tempo su più ricerche, basata su performance e fiducia

  • Onboarding strutturato e affiancamento costante da parte di colleghi senior su metodo, strumenti e processi

  • Un concreto percorso di crescita, dalla ricerca operativa alla gestione diretta di clienti e progetti

Candidati se vuoi metterti alla prova su progetti concreti, sviluppare competenze solide nella selezione commerciale e contribuire alla crescita di una realtà di cui sentirti parte.

raw.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
raw.excerpt: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
raw.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis.
  • Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes.
  • Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems.
  • Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements.
  • Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making.
  • Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods.
  • Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco.

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, reliability engineering, quality analytics, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of owning high-impact problems end to end.
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain.
  • Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems.
  • Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling.
  • Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals.
  • Experience designing experiments or observational analyses that support technical decisions, including an understanding of confounding, bias, uncertainty, and validation.
  • Experience with modern cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, AWS, dbt, Snowflake, or similar tools.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to engineers, quality and operations partners, product leaders, and executives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams and to drive progress when requirements and data are still evolving.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with consumer electronics, wearables, IoT, batteries, embedded systems, firmware, sensors, or connected devices.
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing, supplier, component traceability, MES, ERP, engineering test, or warranty data.
  • Experience with battery degradation, runtime modeling, charging optimization, power management, or electronics reliability.

Blockchain Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Blockchain Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $140,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Blockchain Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade decentralized applications (dApps), smart contract platforms, and blockchain-integrated backend services supporting financial services, digital asset management, and enterprise transaction processing. This role focuses on building secure, scalable blockchain solutions that integrate seamlessly with cloud-native microservices and traditional enterprise applications.
You will work closely with solution architects, security engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to develop smart contracts, blockchain APIs, digital wallet integrations, tokenization platforms, and secure transaction processing systems. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in blockchain protocols, smart contract development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining strong software engineering fundamentals.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop secure smart contracts for enterprise blockchain applications using Solidity or other smart contract languages.
  • Build scalable backend services that interact with blockchain networks for transaction processing, asset management, and identity verification.
  • Develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs to expose blockchain functionality to web and mobile applications.
  • Design blockchain data models, token standards, and transaction workflows for high-volume enterprise systems.
  • Integrate enterprise applications with Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, or other blockchain platforms.
  • Develop secure wallet integrations, digital signature workflows, and key management solutions.
  • Implement blockchain event listeners, indexing services, and off-chain processing components.
  • Build scalable microservices using .NET Core, Java, or Node.js that interact with blockchain networks.
  • Optimize smart contracts for gas efficiency, scalability, and transaction throughput.
  • Perform smart contract audits, security testing, and vulnerability assessments before production deployments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy blockchain infrastructure across Azure or AWS cloud environments.
  • Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and production support activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex blockchain network issues, transaction failures, synchronization problems, and production incidents.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade distributed applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on blockchain development experience delivering production blockchain solutions.
  • Strong experience developing smart contracts using Solidity and Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible networks.
  • Hands-on experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, or Quorum.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js or backend development using C#/.NET Core or Java.
  • Experience building decentralized applications (dApps) with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, Merkle trees, and distributed ledger concepts.
  • Experience implementing ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, or custom token standards.
  • Experience integrating wallets such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, or enterprise custody platforms.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, WebSockets, and blockchain RPC interfaces.
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management.
  • Experience deploying applications on Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting skills in production environments.
  • Experience working within Agile Scrum development teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing enterprise blockchain solutions for financial services, healthcare, insurance, or supply chain industries.
  • Hands-on experience with Hyperledger Fabric chaincode development using Go or Java.
  • Experience with Layer-2 scaling solutions including Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism.
  • Familiarity with Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Multi-Party Computation (MPC), or privacy-preserving blockchain technologies.
  • Experience implementing decentralized identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC).
  • Knowledge of blockchain security standards, smart contract auditing tools, and common vulnerabilities such as reentrancy, overflow, front-running, and flash loan attacks.
  • Experience using Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, Ganache, Brownie, or Remix IDE.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience integrating blockchain applications with enterprise identity providers including Azure Active Directory or OAuth.
  • Blockchain certifications or contributions to open-source blockchain projects are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a team building a next-generation enterprise blockchain platform supporting:
  • Digital asset tokenization and lifecycle management
  • Smart contract-driven business workflows
  • Enterprise wallet and digital identity integration
  • Real-time blockchain event processing
  • Secure multi-signature transaction approval systems
  • Blockchain analytics and reporting dashboards
  • Cloud-native microservices deployed on Azure and AWS
  • High-availability distributed systems supporting millions of secure transactions annually

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll contribute to architecture, development, deployment, security, and operational excellence across mission-critical blockchain solutions.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

Description

Build and lead the technical delivery of AI applications within Vi’s Life Science Markets squad. The squad turns large, varied proprietary datasets into products that help evaluate pharmaceutical markets, treatment adoption, competitive dynamics, and drug commercial performance.

This is primarily a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time designing systems, writing production code, integrating models, and shipping AI workflows, while owning technical standards and overall squad delivery. A background in life sciences or capital markets is very helpful, but not required.

What You’ll Own

  • Hands-on delivery: Personally build and ship core AI services and workflows. Own critical implementation work and resolve technical blockers alongside engineers, data scientists, and domain experts.
  • Squad leadership & management: Lead the engineers in the squad and the overall execution. Set implementation standards through your own work, review code and architecture, and coordinate technical priorities and dependencies.
  • Strategy and roadmap: Identify the life sciences market questions where Vi’s data can add value. Prioritize use cases, define success measures, and turn them into a focused roadmap.
  • AI architecture and implementation: Design and implement systems combining ML models, LLMs, retrieval, and workflow automation to address life sciences market questions. Make practical choices about model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Engineering and evaluation quality: Build automated tests, evaluation datasets, and monitoring for AI outputs and application reliability. Maintain rigorous validation of predictive models, including point-in-time backtesting, baseline comparisons, and checks for leakage and coverage bias.
  • Production ownership: Take prototypes into production and own models, APIs, integrations, deployment, observability, and incident resolution. Build reusable capabilities that scale across therapies, companies, and clients.
  • Client partnership & business logic: Work directly with clients and domain experts to understand their analytical workflows, explain findings, challenge assumptions, and turn feedback into product priorities.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong record of personally building and shipping production AI applications, with technical ownership of complex systems and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across functions while remaining a primary contributor to design, modeling, coding, debugging, and deployment.
  • Deep practical experience integrating ML models and LLMs into production systems, including retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation. Ability to assess model limitations and choose methods suited to the available data
  • Client-facing engineering: You can run a working session with a client’s technical and non-technical people and come out of it with what will move the needle for them. Ability to translate complex analysis into clear conclusions for senior stakeholders and clients, including what the evidence cannot support..
  • Hands-on depth in scalable data pipelines, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure, ideally on AWS. Comfortable owning both application code and AI deployment.
  • Experience turning bespoke analyses or pilots into products used repeatedly by multiple clients or teams.
  • A background in life sciences, pharmaceutical analytics, or capital markets is very helpful, but not required.

Description

10_Auxiliar de Nómina y RH Bilingüe (Payroll & HR Assistant)

About the role

We are hiring bilingual (English/Spanish) payroll and HR assistants to work 100% remotely from Mexico for companies in Madison, Wisconsin with large hourly and Spanish-speaking workforces: construction, landscaping, cleaning, food processing and manufacturing.

What you will do

Payroll

  • Collect and review timesheets each week; flag missing punches and overtime before payroll closes.
  • Enter weekly or biweekly payroll in the client's payroll system and prepare it for approval.
  • Process new hires, rate changes, deductions, garnishments and terminations.
  • Answer employee questions about pay stubs, hours and direct deposit, in Spanish or English.

HR administration

  • Prepare onboarding packets and track I-9 and W-4 completion.
  • Keep employee files, certifications and PTO balances up to date.
  • Translate HR notices, policies and safety communications into Spanish.
  • Coordinate benefits enrollment paperwork with the client's broker or PEO.

What you bring

Must have

  • 2+ years in payroll, HR administration or both, for a company with hourly workers.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and native or fluent Spanish.
  • Precision with hours, rates and deductions; you double-check before you submit.
  • Discretion with confidential employee data.
  • Intermediate Excel.

Nice to have

  • Experience with U.S. payroll systems: ADP, Paychex, Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll or Paylocity.
  • Familiarity with U.S. forms and concepts: I-9, W-4, overtime rules, garnishments.
  • Experience supporting construction, agriculture or manufacturing crews.
  • Studies in HR, accounting or business administration.

Requirements

Mandatory Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in Payroll and/or HR Administration.
  • Experience processing payroll for hourly employees.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Spanish.
  • Hands-on experience with timesheets, overtime, deductions, and payroll processing.
  • Knowledge of onboarding and employee records.
  • Intermediate Excel skills.
  • High accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
  • U.S. payroll systems: ADP, Paychex, Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll, or Paylocity.
  • Knowledge of I-9, W-4, overtime rules, and garnishments.
  • Experience in construction, manufacturing, landscaping, or similar industries.

raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the IntelePACS Backend team and deliver new backend capabilities for Intelerad's enterprise medical imaging platform.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the IntelePACS Backend team and deliver new backend capabilities for Intelerad's enterprise medical imaging platform. The team is building toward an AI-first way of working, where agentic coding tools are a core part of how we deliver, with the goal of shipping new capabilities at substantially higher velocity. As a senior individual contributor, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, make sound engineering trade-offs in a regulated healthcare environment, and help shape how agentic tooling is integrated into the team's development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own backend features end to end, from scoping, requirements, and estimation through design, development, testing, documentation, and release, delivering against committed timelines within Intelerad's regulated SDLC.

  • Hold a high bar for correctness, testability, and maintainability in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's automated test coverage and CI/CD pipeline.

  • Improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and security of owned components, and resolve defects, security findings, and production escalations.

  • Use agentic coding tools as a routine part of daily development, exercising judgment about which work to delegate to an agent, which to write directly, and how to verify each.

  • Establish repository-level agent context and quality gates, and build agent-assisted workflows that reduce overhead across the development lifecycle.

  • Apply the same review, testing, traceability, and change-control rigour to AI-assisted contributions as to hand-written code, ensuring compliance obligations are fully met.

  • Collaborate with Product Development and cross-functional teams on functionality, user experience, and technical design.

  • Act as a subject matter expert and mentor for less-experienced developers, share AI-augmented engineering practices across the organization, and evaluate emerging tooling.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience developing and maintaining commercial software.

  • Strong Java development experience, including complex, multi-threaded, distributed client/server architectures and best-practice object-oriented design.

  • Professional experience with Linux/UNIX, PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, migrations), and REST APIs and service-to-service integrations.

  • Experience with automated unit and integration testing, Git, and CI/CD tooling.

  • Hands-on experience shipping production code with agentic coding tools, with the ability to explain what you delegate to an agent, what you write yourself, and how you validate the difference.

  • Practical understanding of where agentic tools fail and the review habits needed to catch it, along with experience configuring agent context and guardrails at the repository level.

  • Proven ability to deliver independently in an Agile/Scrum environment, with strong written and verbal communication and the ability to influence others without direct authority.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Integrating agentic AI into a formal, auditable SDLC in a regulated environment.

  • Building internal tooling or agent workflows adopted beyond your own work.

  • Healthcare interoperability: DICOM, HL7, FHIR, DICOMweb, or medical imaging workflows.

  • Regulated environments: FDA, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or quality management systems.

  • AWS services and cloud-native architecture.

  • Security vulnerability remediation, including SAST/SCA tooling and CVE triage.

  • C++, JNI, Perl, or shell scripting.

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time. 

The base pay for this position ranges from $90,000-$120,000 CAD within any geographic market in Canada. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Intelerad uses the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”)as a standard for global recruiting and hiring purposes. This prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. The ADA defines “disability” as a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more of the major life activities of an individual, a record of such impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.

Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. PSI is seeking a Medical Monitor (Oncology) to join our international Medical Monitoring team.

In this role, you will provide medical oversight and expertise across global clinical trials, working closely with study sponsors, investigators, sites, project teams, and other clinical research professionals. Your contribution will help protect participant safety, maintain scientific and medical quality, and support the successful delivery of oncology studies.

This is an opportunity to apply your clinical oncology experience to international research and contribute directly to the development of new treatments for patients who need them.

Full-time employment

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as primary medical point of contact for clinical trial sponsors, internal project teams, investigators and trial sites for medical matters related to the conduct of clinical trials per protocol and per GCP guidelines
  • Provide medical oversight throughout the conduct of clinical trials, in accordance with the protocol, applicable regulations, and ICH-GCP requirements
  • Respond to medical questions from investigators, sites, sponsors, project teams, and third-party vendors
  • Provide medical input into eligibility assessments, protocol deviations, participant safety issues, and other trial-specific medical matters
  • Contribute medical expertise to clinical development plans, protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent documents, annual reports, clinical study reports, patient narratives, and scientific presentations
  • Review and assess clinical and safety data to support participant safety and identify medically relevant trends, risks, or quality concerns
  • Prepares and delivers medical training and/therapeutic area training to investigators and study teams
  • Support medical data review activities and contribute to the assessment of aggregated clinical trial data
  • Participate in bid defense meetings and proposal activities
  • Provide support with Pharmacovigilance activities
  • Identify medical trial risks, and collaborate with relevant functions to define appropriate mitigation and escalation measures
  • Support or participate in advisory boards, safety monitoring boards, and other medical or scientific committees, as applicable.
  • Help ensure that trial conduct and medical oversight activities comply with the approved protocol, applicable regulatory requirements, and quality standards

You will be a strong fit for this role if you have

  • Medical Doctor degree
  • Board certification in Oncology
  • Previous experience as a practicing Oncologist
  • Previous experience in clinical research or the pharmaceutical or CRO industry is a plus
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English
  • Strong medical judgement, analytical thinking, and attention to detail
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex medical information to different stakeholders
  • A collaborative and solution-oriented approach to working within international, cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and confidence working with clinical trial systems and digital collaboration tools.

As part of PSI's Medical Monitoring team, you will become part of an international team of medical professionals working at the frontline of clinical research. You will have the opportunity to apply your oncology expertise across global studies, collaborate with experienced colleagues, and contribute to bringing new treatment options to patients.

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization (CRO) with 30 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Originated in Switzerland, PSI is a privately owned, full-service CRO with a global reach, supporting clinical trials across multiple countries and continents. Our reputation for being highly selective about the projects we undertake highlights our commitment to delivering high-quality, timely services across a broad spectrum of therapeutic indications.

At PSI, we foster an environment where a diverse range of colleagues feel welcomed and valued. Our inclusive culture is a cornerstone of our success, enabling us to attract and retain top talent globally.

We are not just about conducting clinical trials; we are about building a community where every team member has the opportunity to thrive and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the pharmaceutical industry.

raw.description:
Position Purpose:

The EHS&S Solutions Architect translates environmental, health, safety and security business needs into scalable, integrated and supportable digital solutions across CSL. The role owns the EHS&S solution architecture and design framework, partners with EHS&S process owners and Global I&T to define requirements and target-state capabilities, and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture, data, security, validation and governance expectations. The position guides the lifecycle of EHS&S technology solutions from intake and evaluation through design, deployment, integration, adoption and continuous improvement.

Reporting Relationships:

  • Reports to the Global Head, EHS Systems & Compliance

• No direct reports

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

1. Lead large, complex, cross-functional EHS&S technology initiatives, including the strategic solution architecture and multi-year technology roadmap project for the EHS&S digital ecosystem; which is aligned with the multi-year EHS&S strategy.

2. Analyze and document current-state and future-state EHS&S processes, identifying process gaps, control requirements, pain points, standardization opportunities and impacts to roles, data and technology.

3. Lead structured discovery with global and site stakeholders to translate business processes, regulatory requirements and user needs into clear business, functional, reporting, data, integration and non-functional requirements.

4. Develop and maintain process maps, business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution blueprints, interface specifications and requirements traceability through design, testing and deployment.

5. Design scalable end-to-end solutions across EHS&S platforms and adjacent enterprise systems, defining system boundaries, integration patterns, data flows, user roles, controls and authoritative systems of record.

6. Establish solution-intake and design guardrails; assess technology options through fit-gap analysis, technical due diligence and lifecycle considerations, distinguishing configuration or short-term in-house solutions from needs requiring an enterprise or market solution. Lead vendor evaluation and technical due diligence, and manage relationships with EHS&S technology providers to influence product roadmaps and solution decisions.

7. Partner with Global IT, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, validation and enterprise architecture teams to ensure solutions meet applicable technical, security, data-integrity, compliance and lifecycle requirements.

8. Lead and partner with central admin community to develop test scenarios and coordinate user acceptance testing, requirements-based defect triage, business approval, deployment readiness and post-implementation validation against approved requirements and expected outcomes. Serve as coach and mentor for teams and/or individuals to accomplish cross-functional global initiatives.

9. Own and govern the EHS&S metrics and reporting requirements, including reporting calendars, source-data validation, data-quality issue resolution and recurring management outputs; partner with metric owners to maintain documented definitions, calculation logic and reporting controls.

10. Other reporting and analytics requirements and own the reporting and analytics capability, testing, documentation and ongoing enhancement of dashboards, reports and data visualizations; manage the capability backlog, dependencies, technical debt, adoption and transition to sustainable ownership.



Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

Education

Bachelor’s degree in environmental health and safety, engineering, computer science, information systems, data science, business, or a related field. Advanced degree or relevant architecture/technology certification preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in EHS&S, digital solutions, business systems, enterprise applications, solution architecture or a related field, preferably in a global regulated industry.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex business processes into solution requirements and scalable designs across multiple functions, regions or sites.
  • Experience with enterprise EHS&S platforms and their integration with adjacent systems, data platforms, analytics tools and identity/access services.
  • Experience supporting technology selection, implementation, validation, deployment and transition to sustainable operations.

• Special Training or Competence

  • Relevant certifications in solution or enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, business analysis, project delivery, data management or EHS are preferred (for example, TOGAF, Azure, CBAP, PMP or CSP).

Competencies

  • Expert in solution architecture, process design, requirements definition, systems integration, data flows and application lifecycle governance.
  • Working knowledge of EHS&S management systems and processes, including incident management, risk assessment, compliance obligations, audits, CAPA, occupational health, environmental management and sustainability reporting.
  • Ability to distinguish business requirements from proposed solutions and guide stakeholders toward simple, scalable and supportable designs.
  • Strong stakeholder facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, trade-offs and decisions to business and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across global, cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical judgment, structured problem solving, documentation discipline and attention to data quality and controls.
  • Knowledge of regulated-industry expectations for data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, validation and change control is preferred.

About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

We Are:

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


You Are:

A seasoned SAP Finance Data Architect with deep retail and fashion industry expertise and a passion for designing the finance information model that clients run their business on. You have led clients through full-cycle SAP Finance transformations — from initial planning and analysis through build, test, and deployment — and you know how to translate ambitious reporting and profitability goals into a clear, governed finance data structure. You are equally comfortable workshopping the chart of accounts with a Corporate Controller, aligning profit center and segment design with a CFO, or coaching a junior consultant through a master data design decision.


You bring specific depth in defining the finance coding block for retail and fashion — chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, segments, and profitability characteristics — and in making design choices that balance statutory requirements, management reporting needs across brands, banners, channels, stores and seasons, and long-term data governance.


The Work:


As an SAP Finance Data Architect in Retail & Fashion you will:


  • Engage senior client Finance executives on how the finance information model supports business strategy, profitability transparency, and reporting — current and future.
  • Lead the definition of the finance information model across all phases of full-cycle SAP delivery: Plan, Analyze, Build, Test, and Deploy.
  • Define and govern the finance coding block for S/4HANA Finance: operational and group chart of accounts, company code and controlling area structure, cost center and profit center hierarchies, segments, functional areas, and other account assignment objects.
  • Design profit center and segment structures that deliver P&L visibility by brand, banner, channel (store, wholesale, e-commerce, franchise), region, and category, aligned with merchandise, article, and location hierarchies.
  • Define profitability analysis (Margin Analysis) characteristics and value fields, and the allocation, assessment, and cost-to-serve logic that supports retail and fashion margin reporting, including season and collection views.
  • Establish finance master data governance — ownership, standards, naming conventions, and change processes — including SAP MDG-F, and lead the mapping and migration of legacy structures to the target model.
  • Lead large, diverse project teams (onshore and offshore), maintaining quality, scope, and stakeholder alignment throughout delivery.
  • Advise on SAP's Business AI strategy — identifying where well-structured finance data can enable AI-driven insight, automation, and predictive accounting in Finance and Retail operations.
  • Contribute to thought leadership, reusable assets, and best-practice templates (e.g., retail and fashion reference chart of accounts and profit center models) to grow Accenture's SAP Retail capability.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience leading clients through full-cycle SAP Finance delivery across all phases — Plan, Analyze, Build, Test, and Deploy — as a Finance Data Architect.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience delivering SAP Finance transformations for Retail or Fashion clients (Grocery, Specialty, or Fashion preferred), with a focus on finance information model and master data design.
  • Minimum 5 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementations including project planning, estimation, finance design, and go-live (SAP support / managed services experience alone will not satisfy the implementation requirement)
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in finance data architecture and governance across S/4HANA, SAP MDG-F, data migration and legacy-to-target mapping, SAC/BW analytics, integration with IS-Retail/CAR, POS, and e-commerce, RISE with SAP, and financial controls/compliance.
  • Deep expertise in defining the finance information model — chart of accounts (operational, group, and country/statutory), company code and controlling area design, cost center and profit center accounting and hierarchies, segment reporting, functional areas, internal orders and WBS, and the Universal Journal (ACDOCA) — including account determination, document splitting, and the impact of design choices on reporting, controls, and statutory requirements.
  • Strong retail and fashion domain experience in structuring the finance model for multi-brand, multi-banner, and omnichannel P store, distribution center, and e-commerce profit center design; merchandise and article hierarchy alignment; inventory valuation and merchandise accounting; franchise and wholesale accounting; season and collection reporting; and Margin Analysis characteristics.
  • Prior experience in a consulting or advisory capacity with direct client-facing accountability.
  • Experience enabling AI-driven use cases within SAP programs, including Joule, embedded AI, and predictive accounting, and an understanding of how finance data quality and structure underpin them.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate's Degree, must have equivalent minimum of 6 years' work experience.

Bonus Points if:

  • You have SAP S/4HANA Finance certification, such as SAP Certified Application Associate or an equivalent Finance certification.
  • You have Experience applying SAP Activate methodology and leading Agile delivery and sprint execution within SAP transformation programs.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

JOB SUMMARY


The Sr Technical Sourcing Manager is responsible and accountable for orchestrating the supplier selection process and part validation process for three major facets of Jabil’s needs: (1) Design, (2) NPI, (3) Risk/Cost Reduction. This position requires situational analysis to leverage Jabil’s Supply Chain and Sourcing organizations as well as Jabil’s tools, templates, and processes to ensure we are identifying, validating, and deploying components into Jabil’s supply base correctly. This role must shift and adapt quickly to changing project requirements and act with a sense of urgency. Support of multiple projects/customers and have direct reports is possible. This role will require direct customer and supplier interface as well as engagement with executive stakeholders.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Design Projects:

  • Accountable for BOM pricing as it evolves through each design and mass production milestone.
  • Responsible for resolving cost differences and addressing supply chain impacts due to BOM changes, design shifts, and scope changes. Responsible for providing detailed explanation for any unresolved issues.
  • Solicits and manages supplier Design for Manufacturability (DFM) recommendations as required. Interprets supplier feedback to provide clear guidance on product and/or process optimization.
  • Manages the supplier selection process in alignment with commodity management.
  • Accountable for supplier negotiations and risk mitigation as required.
  • Provides guidance to direct reports and buyers to maintain clean-to-build part status for all design phases.
  • Accountable for driving Early Supplier Involvement.

NPI Projects:

  • Where assigned, manages a supply chain strategy for all components identified as Jabil’s ownership.
  • Manages qualification process of components and suppliers under Jabil ownership, including but not limited to DFM, FOT, PPAP, and APQP.
  • Accountable for supplier negotiations and risk mitigation as required.
  • Provides guidance to direct reports and buyers to maintain clean-to-build part status for all design phases.
  • Works with NPI buyer and selected suppliers to optimize and minimize on hand inventory.

Risk/Cost Reduction:

  • Where assigned, accountable for supply chain projects including cost optimization, quality improvement, and supply assurance in alignment with commodity management.
  • Leads purchasing organization with short-term/high-risk quality issues, line down constraints, and supplier negotiations.
  • Takes guidance from senior team members, SCDMs, SSMs, and Business Unit on Risk/Cost Reduction projects and manages building value propositions.

Additional Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Accountable for Supply Chain & Sourcing deliverables per Jabil’s current templates, software solutions, and processes.
  • Engages in cost estimating on a variety of custom parts.
  • Accountable for successful handoff to production teams by confirming all selected components are fully qualified, validated, and ready for procurement per Jabil and Customer guidelines.
  • Leads identification and deployment of Jabil process improvements.
  • Adheres to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
  • Complies, follows, and enforces all procedures within the company security policy.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS


  • A Bachelor’s degree (preferably in Mechanical Engineering and Design or Supply Chain)
  • 12 years or more of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Masters degree in Supply Chain Management is preferred.
  • This job requires up to 40-50% travel.

LANGUAGE SKILLS


  • Advanced PC skills, with emphasis on Excel, Word, and Powerpoint.
  • Ability to read, analyze, interpret, and communicate regarding common scientific and/or technical journals.
  • Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.
  • Ability to effectively present information to Senior Management and Customers; Ability to read and speak English.
  • Ability to read and interpret 2D and 3D drawings and identify key information to manufacture a component such as followingGD&T guidelines.

REASONING ABILITY


  • Strong problem solving, analytic, negotiation, project management and people skills are a must.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, summarize information and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
  • Ability to solve practical problems with limited information.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS


  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure with constantly changing priorities and deadlines.
  • Individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly and occasionally lift up to 15 lbs.
  • Be accessible to production floor and office staff and to use required office equipment.
  • Specific vision requirements include reading of written documents and use of computer monitor screen frequently

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Individual’s primary workstation is located in the office area. The noise level in this environment is typically low.

The pay range for this role is $126,100 - $227,000. About CrowdHealth:

CrowdHealth is helping Members live boldly without the fear and stress related to health care bills. No doctor networks. No huge monthly premiums. No annual deductibles. No surprises. We’re a community-powered alternative to health insurance, enabling individuals to access and fund healthcare with transparency, simplicity, and control.

Purpose

To ensure CrowdHealth Members' medical expenses are reviewed, managed, and crowdfunded efficiently, transparently, and in alignment with community standards—helping Members trust that their contributions are being used fairly and responsibly.

Scope

As a Crowdfunding Specialist, you will manage the flow of healthcare expenses through the CrowdHealth platform—from reviewing submitted bills, evaluating eligibility, and finalizing expenses to coordinating the crowdfunding process and ensuring Member accounts are accurately maintained. Your responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing healthcare bills and adherence to Membership guidelines
  • Facilitating the crowdfunding process
  • Evaluate fair pricing for bills
  • Supporting a seamless Member experience around health events and expense handling

This is a full-time remote position reporting to the Crowdfund Manager.

Expected Outcome

CrowdHealth Members experience a transparent, trustworthy, and well-managed funding process for major medical events—resulting in:

  • High Member confidence in how their bills are funded
  • Successful crowdfunding of valid, fairly priced care
  • High levels of Member satisfaction and community engagement

Responsibilities

Health Event & Cost Administration

  • Assess bills for completeness, eligibility, and fair market pricing.
  • Coordinate with Care Advocates to resolve questions or gather additional information.
  • Submit bills for negotiation when pricing is excessive.
  • Respond to Member requests and questions quickly and professionally
  • Collaborate with team members to continuously improve the Member experience.

Crowdfunding Management

  • Submit eligible bills for crowdfunding
  • Troubleshoot and resolve crowdfunding issues
  • Handle failed payments, refunds, and cancellations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in public or private accounting, including reconciliations and financial operations
  • Healthcare experience, with a strong background in healthcare billing and administration
  • Passion for improving how people access and pay for healthcare in the U.S.

Skills & Competencies

  • Analytical mindset: Strong attention to detail and ability to assess legitimacy and fairness of submitted bills
  • Financial accuracy: Comfortable reconciling accounts, and recording entries precisely
  • Critical thinking: Able to evaluate complex healthcare scenarios and recommend solutions aligned with CrowdHealth policies
  • Process-driven: Strong organization, time management, and ability to manage multiple cases in various stages
  • Technical proficiency: Skilled in Excel and familiar with platforms like ZenDesk, Slack, and internal operations tools
  • Team orientation: Collaborative, communicative, and supportive of other team members' work in delivering an excellent Member experience
  • Empathy & trustworthiness: Committed to handling Member contributions with integrity and care

Join Us

If you’re excited by the idea of joining a company that’s rewriting the rules of healthcare, focused on legit loving people, and helping people exit a broken system, we’d love to talk.

We are currently accepting applications from candidates in any state other than New York, California, New Jersey, and Rhode Island.
