raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

  • Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

Job Summary and Purpose:

TMF Lead is responsible for supporting project teams in maintaining a high quality TMF in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), other guidance documents, and Precision Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Senior TMF Lead takes on responsibility for the complex or challenging studies requiring an experienced TMF Lead. Additionally, the Senior TMF Lead supports and mentors more inexperienced TMF Leads.

Main Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that TMF document review and processing, periodic quality review, set up, maintenance, finalization and archival of study TMFs is completed in a timely manner and with a high quality.
  • Create and execute the study TMF Plan and project TMF Document Index. Ensure entire study team understands expectations, project-specific aspects of the TMF, and manage communication of any changes in the TMF Plan or Index to the project team.
  • Ensure that TMF documentation (e.g. TMF Plan, TMF Index, Periodic Quality Review documentation) is filed in the TMF.
  • Attend and contribute to project kick-off meetings, project internal or external meetings, and ad hoc meetings as needed to ensure the project team is aware of the status of the TMF, potential gaps and escalations.
  • Engage and collaborate with the Project Manager and Functional Leads to ensure TMF documentation is submitted in a timely manner and with high quality in order to maintain the TMF in an inspection-ready state.
  • Proactively anticipate challenges to TMF compliance and identify early signals of risk. Develop and implement plans to increase compliance and follows-up on non compliance. Follows TMF escalation process as needed.
  • Ensure that TMF Risks are identified and appropriately documented and mitigated.
  • Monitor and report on TMF Health and Metrics and escalate non-compliances and potential issues to internal team and Senior Leadership as required. Identify trends, risks, and overall status of the TMF and suggest mitigation strategies.
  • Serve as point of contact and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for project audits or inspections and support in the report responses. Participate in Audit/Inspection interview. Escalate to TMF management in cases of significant risk to Precision.
  • Ensure provision of TMF analytics and expertise to Sponsors.
  • Ensure that Periodic Quality Review for assigned projects is initiated and performed by the Quality Review Specialists and ensure proper documentation.
  • Ensure that document review and processing for assigned projects is performed by the Document Specialists on a timely and consistent basis.
  • Identify project team TMF training needs and provide or support team re-education.
  • Manage the close-out activities of assigned studies, including defining the timeline for final document submission, final document processing, close out of all outstanding queries, requesting the eTMF export from the vendor, transfer to the sponsor and collect the Acknowledgement of Receipt.
  • Manage projects within the Sponsor eTMF System and actively listen to deliver insightful solutions for challenges.
  • Monitor and report potential out of scope activities related to Records Management, communicate these to the TMF manager and Project Manager, and ensure out of scope tasks are properly added to change orders, if needed.
  • Support and mentor less experienced TMF Leads on the performance of their role and problem-solving study-specific issues.

Minimum Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) +5 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.

  • Working knowledge of FDA & ICH/GCP regulations and guidelines
  • Demonstrates solid interpersonal skills
  • Ability to identify issues and escalate appropriately and effectively
  • Excellent organizational skills, time management, and ability to coordinate workload and meet established deadlines
  • Manage competing priorities effectively
  • Demonstrates, or is able to be trained and retain a working knowledge of ICH-GCP, and relevant Precision SOPs and regulatory guidance
  • Exhibits strong self-motivation, is detail-oriented and able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment

  • Communicates both verbally and in written form in an efficient and professional manner

raw.description:
First Media is looking for an experienced Creative Strategist with a strong track record of developing creative strategies for new client and product launches.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take a client and product new to First Media, understand its market and potential customers, and turn research and consumer insights into compelling advertising concepts and scripts that drive customer acquisition.

You'll be responsible for identifying key audience segments, understanding their motivations and purchase behaviors, developing creative angles and messaging, and building an initial creative testing strategy. You'll need to be comfortable making informed decisions with limited historical performance data, using research, creative judgment, and proven performance marketing best practices to guide your approach.

Working closely with our production and media teams, you'll take creative from initial research through to scripting, production and launch.

What You'll Do

  • Lead launch research: Develop a strong understanding of new clients' products, markets, competitors and value propositions. Research customer segments, motivations, pain points and purchase triggers to identify the strongest creative opportunities.
  • Develop audience-led creative strategies: Translate consumer insights into distinct messaging angles, creative concepts, and testing strategies tailored to different customer groups.
  • Concept and script: Write compelling direct-response advertising concepts, hooks, and scripts for paid social, ensuring creative communicates the product's value and resonates with the intended audience.
  • Apply launch best practices: Use proven creative frameworks, performance marketing principles and previous campaign learnings to establish effective initial testing strategies for new clients.
  • Make informed creative decisions: Confidently develop and prioritize creative hypotheses when historical performance data is limited, using research, experience and commercial judgment.
  • Guide creative execution: Brief and collaborate with producers, editors and designers to bring concepts to life, providing clear creative direction and feedback.
  • Learn and optimize: Work with performance marketing teams to evaluate early results, identify opportunities, and evolve the creative strategy as campaign data develops.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Creative Strategist, Performance Creative Strategist, Direct Response Copywriter, or similar.
  • Demonstrable experience developing creative strategies for new client, product, or brand launches, ideally within an agency or performance marketing environment.
  • Strong consumer research skills, with the ability to identify distinct audience segments, understand customer psychology, and uncover compelling purchase motivations.
  • Exceptional conceptual thinking and copywriting skills, with experience developing direct-response advertising concepts, hooks, and scripts.
  • Strong understanding of paid social advertising, particularly Meta, and how creative influences customer acquisition and campaign performance.
  • Comfortable working with limited historical data, forming hypotheses and making strategic creative recommendations from research and experience.
  • Experience collaborating with production, creative, and performance marketing teams.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and a portfolio of relevant creative work. We're particularly interested in examples of new client or product launches you've worked on, including how you approached the research, identified audiences, developed the creative strategy, and translated it into advertising concepts.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Inside Sales Manager is a senior level commercial position responsible for strategically leading the Inside Sales Team. As the team leader, the Inside Sales Manager is accountable to develop inside sales strategies and tactics to support the outside sales team and grow our customer base. The team assesses and handles inbound lead calls, makes outbound sales and customer retention calls, and gathers critical sales opportunity information to pass to the field sales team. Working closely with field sales management colleagues, the Inside Sales Manager leading the Inside Sales Representatives, will develop and implement action plans to increase the customer base, maximize sales revenue and increase market share by demonstrating commitment to surpass our customers’ expectations.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversee daily activities performed by the Inside Sales Team and support all escalations, driving each member toward expected weekly, monthly and quarterly goals through regular coaching and 1:1's.

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to develop and execute on quarterly call campaigns.

  • Coordinates budgets, organizing and implementing sales strategies, and is responsible for achieving overall sales objectives.

  • In conjunction with marketing and sales management, develop new product scripts and advanced qualifying questions for call campaigns.

  • Maintain and develop Inside Sales processes, lead generation, and quarterly project planning, to establish an approach for successful solution selling.

  • Develop and publish weekly/monthly performance dashboard reports for each Inside Sales Representative utilizing data captured through CRM module activity details and call metrics.

  • Prepare and present quarterly analysis to Senior Management on Inside Sales Team activities related to bookings, lead generation, meeting and quote opportunities.

  • Create monthly project summary to share with stakeholders, providing project details such as project overview, starts/end dates, number of sites to call, and setting appropriate metrics to evaluate results.

  • Influence internal and external stakeholders, such as members within Sales Administration Management, C-level, and Marketing, to help remove obstacles and support goal achievement of the Inside Sales Team.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required.

  • 2+ years of inside sales management experience.

  • 2+ year of sales experience Computer proficient in Microsoft software applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and proficiency with Sales Automation tools.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Sales coaching and strong relationship building skills.

  • Possesses excellent oral communication/interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to develop and grow customer relationships to secure future and recurring business.

  • Must be able to drive sales growth and achieve team goals.

  • Enthusiasm for working with a professional selling team.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. raw.description:
About Lingoda
Founded 12 years ago, Lingoda addresses a pressing global challenge: meeting the demands of growing economies and aging populations through the mobility of global talent. Driven by its mission "to empower global talent with the language, cultural, and technical skills for integration and success", Lingoda has established itself as a leader in education.
What We Do
Lingoda’s highly effective Small Group Learning Model is delivered via over 800,000 classes a year, powered by 2,400 qualified teachers and a unique proprietary curriculum designed to help learners achieve their goals, whether that be career progression or integration into a new country.
Who We Serve
A rapidly growing and ambitious company, Lingoda operates in both B2B and B2C: while the B2B business has a strong focus on the healthcare sector in Germany and a credible ambition to expand into other professions and geographies, Lingoda’s B2C business has a global presence, teaching German, English, Spanish, French, and Italian to students worldwide.
Learning a language with Lingoda is a rewarding experience, made possible by us Lingodies who support our students every step of the way. We’re committed to living the learning journey alongside them to create a world of connection and opportunity.

Why Join Us?Joining Lingoda means becoming part of a team that's committed to getting better, together. We foster and inclusive culture of bravery, curiosity and growth, where insight turns into actions, and every team member contributes to igniting positive change

Be part of our journey to transform lives through Education!
We are bringing our paid acquisition in-house and looking for an analytical, execution-driven SeniorPaid Marketing Manager (all genders) to take direct ownership of our multi-brand paid media portfolio.

Ideally you are based in Berlin, however we are open to working in other parts of Germany
Your mission with us:
You will take over our paid acquisition from an external agency and build a unified, in-house growth engine. Your immediate focus will be our core B2C verticals: scaling our approbation support for international doctors with Match Doctors (approbation guidance and preparation courses) and driving sign-ups for Curani (100% health-insurance-funded home care courses for family caregivers under § 45 SGB XI).

As these funnels mature, you will expand into our B2B brands: driving clinic partnerships for Match Pflege, institutional medical German training for Lingoda Healthcare, and corporate language programs for Lingoda for Business.
Because our conversions involve high consideration and distinct qualification cycles (approbation pathways, statutory care insurance coverage, and B2B clinic procurement), you won’t just optimize for form-fills. You will connect the dots between ad spend and closed outcomes, partnering directly with our sales teams.

You will have strong backing and project ownership with following resources: in-house creative and video talent to produce assets on demand, plus support with tracking infrastructure.

Your tasks:

  • In-House Campaign Ownership: Transition active Google and Meta accounts away from our agency; audit, restructure, and scale spend from €70k/month upwards across brands.
  • Proactive Growth & Initiative: Take full ownership of testing bold new tactics, bidding strategies, and untapped angles with a clear mandate to drive lead volume up while driving CPL down.
  • Google Ads Engine (Search, PMax, YouTube): Run high-intent search campaigns capturing niche medical terms, foreign medical qualification recognition (Approbation, FSP/KP), insurance-funded caregiving education, and corporate language solutions.
  • Paid Social & Channel Expansion: Scale Meta lead generation and spearhead testing across emerging channels, prioritizing YouTube, TikTok, and conversational/AI search discovery.
  • Lead Quality & Downstream Funnel Feedback: Partner closely with sales teams to analyze downstream lead quality. Optimize bidding algorithms around qualified leads and customers rather than top-of-funnel clicks.
  • Structured Experimentation Rhythm: Establish and run a weekly testing sprint—hypothesizing, deploying, and analyzing 2–3 new hooks, audiences, form variations, or value propositions every week with clear, documented learnings.
  • AI-Assisted Workflows: Leverage generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) to accelerate German ad copy ideation, translate technical/medical nuances, and rapidly brainstorm hook variations before briefing the creative team.
  • Visual Reporting & Strategic Storytelling: Build and maintain clean, visual dashboards (Looker Studio) tracking blended CAC, brand-level CPL, and downstream conversion rates. Present clear, actionable optimization roadmaps directly to leadership.
  • Landing Page & CRO Optimization: Partner closely with our Product Marketing Manager to optimize landing pages and post-click user journeys; formulate conversion rate optimization (CRO) hypotheses, test form friction (multi-step vs. single-page questionnaires), reinforce trust signals, and align messaging around insurance-funded benefits.
  • Creative Direction: Feed real-time performance data back to our in-house video and design team with precise, actionable creative briefs for hooks, angles, and visual formats.
  • Tracking Collaboration: Define technical tracking requirements (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, offline conversion uploads) and partner with our developers to implement and maintain them.

You bring to Lingoda

  • Relevant Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience managing at least €50k+/month in direct ad spend across Google Ads and Paid Social in B2C and B2B focused businesses.
  • Niche & Long-Cycle Expertise: Proven success generating leads in niche, high-consideration verticals with multi-step or extended qualification journeys (e.g., healthcare, education, recruitment/staffing, insurance-backed services, or B2B).
  • Deep Google Ads & Meta Competence: Hands-on mastery of Google Ads (Smart Bidding strategies, Search, PMax) and Meta Ads Manager.
  • Data Fluency & Visual Presentation: Strong ability to build visual reports (Looker Studio or similar), spot funnel drop-offs, and present data-backed recommendations to leadership.
  • Experimentation Drive: Demonstrated track record of taking initiative—testing new channels, ad formats, and angles autonomously to systematically bring down acquisition costs.
  • Tracking & Attribution Acumen: Solid understanding of conversion pixels, UTM hygiene, event tracking, and how offline CRM conversions map back into Google and Meta.
  • Language Proficiency:
  • German (C1–C2): Required for deep keyword research, nuanced ad copy, landing page messaging, and understanding German healthcare/regulatory terminology.
  • English (C1): Required for internal team collaboration as working language is English
Bonus Skills:
  • Understanding of publicly funded or insurance-subsidized education/care models in Germany (Pflegekasse, § 45 SGB XI, or Bildungsgutschein), previous experience in health/education industry in Germany

What you can expect from Lingoda:

  • Approachable leaders and transparent communication - every voice counts at Lingoda!
  • Company events and colleagues who are always happy to socialise + budgets towards team building events!
  • An inclusive environment with great team spirit and passion for languages
  • A well-structured and exciting onboarding process to set you up for success!
  • The possibility to work remotely from your home or in the office located in the heart of Berlin
  • Learning & development opportunities
  • Free access to our language classes
  • Mental Health programs
  • Corporate benefits & pension funds
  • 30 vacation days per year
  • Free snacks & drinks at the office
  • The modern hardware necessary for your work (n/a for freelancers)
  • Flexible working hours
Lingoda is dedicated to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace. As an equal opportunities and affirmative action employer, we strive to create a workforce that reflects the diversity of our user base. Our commitment ensures that every applicant is assessed on the basis of their skills and qualifications, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or religion.
We ask that you please apply directly via the link provided in the job description or directly on our website. Due to GDPR regulations, applications sent otherwise will not be considered.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for Developer Productivity Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.

  • Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.

  • Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.excerpt: About the CompanyArmada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty.
raw.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

As a Senior Accountant at Armada, you will be a key member of our growing Finance team, responsible for maintaining the integrity of our financial records as we scale rapidly. You will manage assigned areas of the general ledger function, support month-end and year-end close processes, and partner cross-functionally with teams across the business to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.

This is a general GL role with real breadth. Depending on business needs, your scope will span AP, AR, revenue, expenses, fixed assets and depreciation, debt, and leases, and it will shift as Armada grows. Our Galleon program (modular, deployed data centers) is a core part of the business and a meaningful piece of this role, including inventory, CIP, capitalization, and fixed asset accounting, but it is one of several areas you will cover rather than the whole job.

The ideal candidate is technically strong, highly organized, and excited about building scalable processes at one of the most exciting companies in AI infrastructure. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership, and enjoys building scalable processes in a high-growth environment.

Location. This role is remote-based in SF Bay Area, NYC, or Seattle.  

Main responsibilities:

General Accounting & Close Responsibilities

  • Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close tasks for assigned areas, following the close calendar and ensuring entries are posted accurately and on time
  • Prepare and post recurring and non-recurring journal entries, accruals, reclasses, and adjustments with clear supporting documentation
  • Prepare and review account reconciliations across balance sheet accounts, tie subledgers to the GL, and investigate and clear reconciling items promptly
  • Perform cash and bank reconciliations, and manage prepaid expense tracking and amortization across vendors and cost categories
  • Review GL activity for misclassifications, cutoff issues, and unusual balances; propose and make corrections before the books are finalized
  • Maintain close checklists and supporting schedules; flag late inputs, open items, and risks to the Accounting Manager and Controller
  • Assist in preparing monthly financial packages and flux analyses, explaining variances in terms of business drivers
  • Maintain clean, audit-ready workpapers and support external audit and due diligence requests

Transaction Cycles

  • Accounts Payable: Review the AP subledger and vendor accruals; support the invoice-to-pay process, including coding and approvals; ensure proper cutoff and timely reconciliation to the GL
  • Accounts Receivable: Support billing, cash application, collections, and AR aging; review reserves and write-offs; reconcile AR and deferred revenue activity to the GL
  • Revenue: Partner with Revenue Accounting to support revenue recognition under ASC 606, including contract review inputs, deferred revenue, and cost of sales matching, including for Galleon-related transactions
  • Expenses: Review operating expenses, T&E, payroll, benefits, and commissions entries; monitor accruals, prepaids, and budget-to-actual variances with department owners
  • Fixed Assets & Depreciation: Maintain the fixed asset subledger and depreciation schedules (including useful lives and methodologies); manage CIP and timely capitalization; reconcile monthly to the GL
  • Debt & Financing: Maintain debt schedules and record drawdowns, interest, fees, and covenant-related support; coordinate with Treasury and Finance leadership on financing activity
  • Leases: Maintain ASC 842 lease schedules for office and equipment leases, including new leases, modifications, ROU assets, and lease liabilities; reconcile to the GL
  • Inventory & Insurance: Support inventory and CIP accounting, capitalization of freight, installation, and other directly attributable costs, and prepaid insurance balances and claims

Galleon Program Support

  • Serve as an accounting resource for Galleon transactions across procurement, inventory, CIP, capitalization, deployment, redeployment, retirement, and disposal
  • Help administer the Company's fixed asset management system (NetAsset), ensuring accurate asset records and supporting process improvements
  • Track Galleon movements to keep the fixed asset subledger aligned with current fleet status; support physical inventory and fixed asset counts and resolve discrepancies

Cross-Functional & Process Improvement

  • Partner with FP&A on capex, depreciation, and expense forecasting
  • Act as a finance partner to Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, and HR/Payroll, providing accounting guidance and ensuring proper documentation
  • Partner with Revenue Accounting and Finance leadership on accounting considerations related to customer arrangements and new business models
  • Design and maintain internal controls over your assigned cycles and keep process documentation (SOPs) current
  • Identify automation opportunities and help scale accounting processes, ERP workflows, and reporting capabilities
  • Assist with technical accounting research, policy development, and special projects as the company grows

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; Active CPA license required
  • 4–6+ years of progressive accounting experience. We prefer a combination of public accounting (Big 4 or regional firm) and corporate accounting, with hands-on, in-house GL experience valued as much as audit background. Experience in high-growth or startup environments is strongly preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required, including the ability to analyze large datasets, build scalable reconciliations, and develop efficient reporting schedules. Experience with Power Query or similar automation tools is a plus
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP across the full GL, including ASC 606 (Revenue), ASC 842 (Leases), ASC 360 (Fixed Assets), ASC 470 (Debt), and internal controls; familiarity with ASC 330 (Inventory) is a plus
  • Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms; exposure to AP/spend management, billing, and payroll systems is a plus
  • Broad general accounting experience across several of AP, AR, revenue, fixed assets, debt, and leases; experience with capital-intensive operations or fixed asset programs is a plus
  • Demonstrated success improving accounting processes, implementing controls, or supporting system enhancements
  • High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership
  • Excellent communication skills; able to translate complex accounting concepts for cross-functional partners
  • Strong sense of accountability, business judgment, and a proactive approach to problem solving

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

  • Tier 1 (e.g., SF Bay Area, NYC, Seattle): $100,104 – $125,005
  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $86,960 – $108,700
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $82,612 - $103,265

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)
  • Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)
  • Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays per year
Compensation
$86,960—$108,700 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

You'll partner closely with the head of ML to drive our tech strategy and ensure our members get the best experience possible on the core surface of our product.

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, has deep experience with production recommender systems, and has intuitive product-focused user empathy.

We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they’ve never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity.

Responsibilities

  • Build, coach, and retain a high-performing backend team that specializes in recommender systems.

  • Own reliable, low-latency production systems, observability, and incident response for recommendations. Catch regressions in latency, quality, or fairness before users notice.

  • Create and execute a technical strategy that is grounded in deep product intuition and empathy for the end-user experience.

  • Partner with the Machine Learning team to define roadmaps. Balance user-facing improvements with investments in infrastructure, reliability, and experimentation.

  • Work with Data Science to co-own experimentation processes, tools, and best practices.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years managing engineers, with direct responsibility for hiring, performance management, career development, and delivery.

  • Experience leading or building production recommender systems at scale.

  • Hands-on depth in high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems that serve millions of users.

  • Expertise in Go, Java/JVM, or a similar backend language; Postgres, and AWS/GCP, and Kubernetes.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience with social networks or two-sided marketplaces in a subscription setting: you understand reciprocal interest, exposure, liquidity, and how great recommendations create long-term retentive value.

  • Familiarity with how machine learning and AI fit into modern recommender systems.

  • Experience with retrieval infrastructure such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, vector search, or feature stores.

raw.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

Nadia Care is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our mission-driven engineering team. You will be a high-impact individual contributor responsible for building and scaling technical solutions that improve maternal health outcomes. This role requires a blend of product-minded development and a deep commitment to operational excellence in a regulated healthcare environment.

You will collaborate closely with product, clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to build our next generation care team and member facing applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Stack Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable features across our mobile web platforms using React and Python.
  • Care-Team Automation: Develop AI-native workflows to automate internal administrative tasks, such as AI-assisted documentation and member summaries, to reduce manual work for our care team.
  • Production Reliability: Own the stability and performance of the production environment, utilizing tools like Datadog for monitoring and ensuring HIPAA compliance for PHI.
  • Technical Standards: Set high standards for code quality, testing methodologies, and deployment automation within a small, agile team.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Data, and Clinical Ops teams to translate complex healthcare workflows into practical, high-leverage technical solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a full-stack engineer, ideally within a early stage startup.
  • Expert-level skills in Python, SQL, Typescript/Javascript, and CSS.
  • Deep experience with modern React, MaterialUI, and Tailwind CSS.
  • Prior experience working in regulated environments (e.g., healthcare, fintech) and a strong understanding of HIPAA/PHI security requirements.
  • Ability to navigate technical ambiguity and a proven track record of shipping practical solutions to messy workflow bottlenecks.
  • Problem solver who prioritizes iteration and business impact over perfection
  • Experience with AWS and IaC (AWS CDK, Terraform) strongly preferred.

Why join us:

Working with us is a chance to build something from the ground up, shape the future of maternal health, and grow with a team that values impact, ownership, and care. As an early team member, you’ll help define how we deliver care and support at scale.

At Nadia Care, we recognize that great talent deserves great rewards. The expected base salary for this position is between $140K - $155K annually, based on relevant and direct experience.

Our Interview Process

At Nadia Care, we value transparency and want you to feel prepared at every stage of your candidate journey. Below is our standard interview process for this role:

  1. Recruiter Interview | 30 minutes
  2. Async Codility Technical Assessment | 70 minutes (2-day window)
  3. Hiring Manager Interview | 1 hour
  4. Collaborator Interviews
    1. Engineer Team | 1 hour
    2. Director, Product Strategy & Insights | 30 minutes
  5. Executive Leadership Interview | 30 minutes

Please note that this process is subject to change, but we will always keep you informed along the way.

For full-time employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally:

Time Off That Works for You

  • Recharge with annual paid holidays off.
  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.
  • Full-Time Hourly Employees (Non-Exempt): Receive three weeks of paid time off after the 90-day introductory period.

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage

  • Medical Insurance: Access top-tier healthcare, covering hospital, surgical, and prescription drug benefits. Coverage begins the first of the following month.
  • Dental Insurance: Coverage for preventive care, as well as basic and major procedures.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine eye exams and eyeglasses.

Security & Future Planning Options

  • Stock Option Grant: We believe in shared success.
  • Life Insurance: Financial protection for your beneficiaries.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term and long-term coverage in case of illness or injury.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Opportunity to save for the future.

We’re building something great and want you to be part of it. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contributions make an impact, apply today!

Remote positions are open to candidates in the contiguous US only. Due to operational and compliance requirements, we are unable to hire candidates residing in ND, AL, HI, PR or outside the contiguous US.

Please note that our recruitment team will only contact candidates via an official company email address ending in @nadiacare.com. Be cautious of scams; Nadia Care will never ask for financial information or payments at any stage of the hiring process.

Centauri Health Solutions | 100% Remote | Training and Equipment Provided What if your job was more than a job? What if it was a daily mission to bring clarity, compassion, and critical financial relief to those who need it most? At Centauri Health Solutions, we don’t just process applications; we serve as a lifeline. For many Medicaid members, a single phone call with our team can mean potentially receiving additional monthly cash benefits. We are looking for compassionate and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Bilingual Disability Specialists. If you find deep satisfaction in solving complex problems and advocating for others, your mission starts here. Your Daily Mission (What You’ll Do) You will be a dedicated advocate for our members, the voice of support, and a trusted guide navigating through the Social Security disability process.

Member Champion: Serve as the main point of contact for health plan members, maintaining regular communication, answering questions, and clarifying complex information. Agency Liaison: Manage positive, professional relationships with medical providers, the Social Security offices, and other government agencies to keep applications on track. Application Process Mastery: Gather, verify, and submit all necessary signed forms, medical records, and eligibility data, ensuring a complete and accurate application. This role requires patience, resilience, and the ability to remain positive and professional during challenging conversations. Proactive Case Management: Thoughtfully manage accounts, anticipating requirements, and taking all appropriate actions to secure disability benefits until every method is exhausted. Not every member will be ready to engage. Building trust, overcoming hesitation, and helping members understand available services are important parts of the role. Regulatory Standards: Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA and company information security policies to ensure the safety and confidentiality of all data. Database Navigation: Concurrently manage multiple software systems and databases to track member progress and documentation.

The Ideal Advocate (Who You Are)

Experience: 2+ years in customer service. Experience in social services, case management, disability/claims processing, using contact center software or working with government agencies is a strong plus. Empathetic Communicator: You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to clearly influence and de-escalate situations when needed. This role requires patience, resilience, and the ability to remain positive and professional during challenging conversations. You are fluent in English and Spanish, possessing the ability to speak, read, and write both languages with ease. Meticulously Detail-Oriented: You understand that when helping someone with their benefits, every detail matters. You are goal-driven and willing to learn. Tech-Savvy: You are highly proficient with Microsoft Suite and can navigate multiple platforms and screens smoothly while maintaining a warm conversation. Resilient Multitasker: You can manage your time appropriately, juggle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, and thrive as part of a team.

The Reality of the Role (Transparency Matters) To thrive in this position, you should enjoy a structured, performance-driven environment.

High-Volume Engagement: This is a phone-based role. You will spend 90% of your day managing inbound and outbound calls while staying on top of your case management tasks. This role includes a significant amount of outbound calling. Associates spend much of their day reaching out to members who may not be expecting the call and may initially be hesitant to participate. Complex Casework: You will manage applications from beginning to end, requiring long-term, detailed follow-up and persistence. Training and support are provided, but associates should expect a learning curve as they become comfortable with programs, systems, workflows, and member scenarios. Goal-Oriented: You will be expected to manage your accounts effectively and meet goals related to securing eligibility for your clients. Success in this role requires balancing quality member interactions with productivity and performance expectations. Bonus: You will be eligible to receive bonus payments for exceptional performance.

raw.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Power Systems Study Engineer III

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

This position in DLB’s Mission Critical Department focuses primarily on hyperscale data centers and related mission critical facilities.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will have the opportunity to work with and collaborate with all design staff and further develop their power studies expertise. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team to complete short circuit coordination and arc flash studies on a wide variety of mission critical projects.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments.  Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope.  Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Guide and Direct Power Systems Studies (80%)

Independently perform Power System Studies for mission critical projects. Activities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Equipment Evaluation: Assess the capabilities, ratings, and condition of equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, and capacitors to determine if they meet system requirements.
  • Load Flow Studies: Analyze current and future system load to ensure power delivery without overloading components.
  • Short Circuit Analysis: Evaluate potential fault conditions to determine the system's response and ensure that equipment ratings are not exceeded.
  • Protection Coordination: Study the settings of protective devices such as relays, circuit breakers, and fuses to ensure they coordinate correctly and provide optimal protection.
  • Arc Flash Analysis: Conduct studies to determine potential arc flash hazards, calculate incident energy, and recommend safety practices and protective equipment.
  • Transient Stability Analysis: Evaluate the power system's ability to maintain synchronism after large disturbances, such as faults or sudden changes in load, motor starting, etc.
  • Prepare incremental and final deliverables including breaker settings tables, TCC’s, arc flash labels, and final reports as required by the project scope.
  • Fluent in Power System Study software including one or more of the following:
    • SKM Powertools
    • EasyPower
    • ETAP

Project Management & Reporting (20%)

  • Assist with proposal development including project scope, schedule and budget
  • Timely and effective management of project deliverables including personal workload forecasting and coordination
  • Identify potential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
  • Perform QAQC peer reviews for projects where he or she is not the lead design engineer / power system study specialist.
  • Prepare project reports for internal and external stakeholders for projects which he or she is involved.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (INTERMEDIATE level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of electrical topologies associated with mission critical facilities.
  • Knowledge of the operation, types, and settings of protective devices like relays, circuit breakers, and fuses.
  • Understanding of the ratings, capabilities, and conditions of various power system equipment.
  • Knowledge of industry and safety standards related to power systems, especially concerning arc flash hazards and other safety-related matters.
  • Knowledge of the effects and requirements of connecting new generation or loads to existing systems.
  • Skill in using power system simulation software such as ETAP, PSS/E, SKM, Easy Power, etc.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled at reviewing design drawings and equipment submittals.
  • Skilled in performing code analysis including selection of equipment, wiring, etc. to meet code requirements
  • Skilled in performing code analysis and advanced knowledge of electrical codes
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from ABET accredited institution

PLUS

  • Minimum of five years of electrical engineering experience

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Health reimbursement account (HRA), flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

​NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.
